title: Associate Cluster Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Assistant Cluster Manager (ACM) will be responsible for driving CSR fundraising, corporate partnerships, and business development activities within the assigned region. The role focuses on acquiring and managing CSR clients, developing strategic partnerships, generating funding opportunities, and supporting the achievement of regional revenue targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and acquire new CSR funding opportunities from corporates, PSUs, foundations, and government organizations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with CSR Heads, HR Leaders, CXOs, and key decision\-makers.
* Manage end\-to\-end corporate partnership lifecycle, including prospecting, proposal submission, negotiation, and closure.
* Develop customized CSR proposals, presentations, concept notes, and fundraising pitches.
* Generate and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective donors and partners.
* Achieve assigned revenue and fundraising targets for the cluster.
* Conduct regular client meetings, field visits, and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Coordinate with internal project teams for smooth execution of CSR projects.
* Track opportunities through CRM and maintain accurate partnership records.
* Represent STEM Learning at CSR forums, networking events, and industry meetings.
* Monitor market trends, CSR policies, and funding opportunities to identify new business prospects.
* Support reporting, impact presentations, and donor engagement activities.

**Required Skills**

* Strong B2B Sales and Business Development experience.
* CSR Fundraising and Corporate Partnership Management.
* Excellent Communication, Presentation, and Negotiation Skills.
* Stakeholder and Relationship Management.
* Proposal Writing and Corporate Pitching.
* Government \& PSU Liaisoning (preferred).
* CRM and MS Office proficiency.
* Ability to work independently and achieve targets.
* Willingness to travel extensively for client meetings and field visits.

**Qualification**

* MBA/PGDM (Marketing, Sales, Business Development) or equivalent.
* BSW/MSW candidates with relevant CSR fundraising experience may also be considered.
* 3–5\+ years of experience in CSR Sales, Corporate Fundraising, B2B Sales, NGO Partnerships, or Corporate Relations.

**KPIs / Success Metrics**

* CSR funds raised.
* Number of new corporate partnerships acquired.
* Revenue achievement against targets.
* Proposal\-to\-closure conversion ratio.
* Client retention and relationship growth.
* Pipeline generation and business opportunities created.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

**Website:** https://vibrantick.in

**About the Internship**

Vibrantick Infotech Solutions is looking for detail\-oriented and enthusiastic **Software Testing Interns** who are passionate about ensuring software quality. This internship offers hands\-on experience in testing web applications, mobile applications, ERP/CRM systems, and other software products while working alongside experienced developers and QA professionals.

**Roles \& ResponsibilitiesManual Testing**

* Understand project requirements and software specifications.
* Create and execute test cases and test scenarios.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Verify bug fixes and ensure software quality before release.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support.

**Bug Reporting \& Tracking**

* Identify, reproduce, and document software defects.
* Report bugs with detailed steps, screenshots, and expected vs. actual results.
* Track issues using bug\-tracking tools.
* Coordinate with developers to resolve reported issues.
* Retest resolved defects and validate fixes.

**Web \& Mobile Application Testing**

* Test websites across different browsers and devices.
* Perform responsive design testing.
* Test Android and iOS applications.
* Verify forms, payment gateways, login modules, APIs, and user workflows.

**Database \& API Testing**

* Perform basic database validation using SQL queries.
* Test REST APIs using tools like Postman.
* Validate request and response data.
* Verify API functionality and error handling.

**Performance \& Security Basics**

* Assist in basic performance and load testing.
* Verify application security features such as authentication and authorization.
* Identify usability and performance issues.

**Documentation**

* Prepare test plans, test cases, and test reports.
* Maintain testing documentation for each release.
* Document defects and testing results accurately.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with developers, project managers, and designers.
* Participate in daily stand\-up meetings and project discussions.
* Contribute ideas to improve software quality and testing processes.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Testing concepts.
* Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) and STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle).
* Understanding of manual testing techniques.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Attention to detail and a quality\-focused mindset.
* Ability to work independently and in a team.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic knowledge of SQL.
* Familiarity with Postman or other API testing tools.
* Understanding of bug tracking tools such as Jira, Trello, or Bugzilla.
* Basic knowledge of automation testing tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or any programming language is a plus.

**Eligibility**

* Final\-year students or recent graduates.
* B.Tech, BCA, MCA, M.Tech, Diploma (Computer Science/IT), or any graduate interested in Software Testing.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.

**What You'll Learn**

* Manual Testing techniques.
* Test Case Design and Execution.
* Bug Reporting and Defect Management.
* API Testing using Postman.
* Database Testing with SQL.
* Cross\-browser and Mobile Testing.
* QA Documentation Standards.
* Agile Testing Methodologies.
* Basics of Automation Testing.
* Real\-time software testing on live client projects.

**Perks \& Benefits**

description:
**Site Engineer – Luxury Resort Construction** Surya Group of Hotels and Resorts \| Angul, Odisha \| Full\-Time

**About the Project**

Surya Group of Hotels and Resorts is developing a landmark luxury eco\-resort near Satkosia Tiger Reserve, Angul, Odisha. This is one of Eastern India's most ambitious hospitality construction projects and we are building a strong site team to match the scale of it.

We are hiring a Site Engineer who will work directly under the Project Manager and own day\-to\-day execution on the ground.

**What This Role Is**

This is a hands\-on execution role. You will be present on site every day, supervising work, checking quality, coordinating with contractors, and making sure what gets built matches what was designed. If you are someone who needs to be chased to walk the site, this is not the role for you. If you are someone who finds problems before anyone else does, keep reading.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Supervise daily construction activities including RCC works, masonry, plastering, tiling, and finishing
* Read and interpret architectural, structural, and MEP drawings and ensure execution matches design intent
* Monitor contractor and labour performance on site and flag deviations immediately
* Conduct quality checks at every stage of construction and maintain site quality records
* Coordinate with subcontractors for electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and external development works
* Track material delivery schedules and raise indents for materials in advance to avoid delays
* Maintain daily site progress reports, work diaries, and photographic records
* Assist the Project Manager in preparing weekly progress updates and flagging critical issues
* Ensure safety protocols are followed on site at all times
* Coordinate with architects and consultants during site visits and resolve on\-ground queries
* Support procurement activities including material inspection and vendor coordination
* Monitor formwork, reinforcement, and concrete works and ensure compliance with structural drawings

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering
* Minimum 3 to 7 years of experience in building construction
* Hands\-on experience supervising RCC, masonry, finishing, and structural works on site
* Ability to read and interpret civil, architectural, and structural drawings
* Experience coordinating with multiple subcontractors and trades simultaneously
* Strong understanding of construction quality standards and site safety practices

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on hotel, resort, or premium commercial projects
* Familiarity with luxury finishes, high\-end material specifications, and brand quality standards, interior finishing and furnishings
* AutoCAD, Excel, Stadd
* Experience with facade works, stone cladding, or specialty finishes is an advantage

**What Working Here Looks Like**

You will be part of a lean, serious site team working on a project that most engineers in Odisha will talk about for years. The site is near Satkosia Tiger Reserve. The finish standards are luxury hospitality. The pace is demanding and the expectations are high.

If you deliver here, Surya Group has a second resort at Deomali already in planning. The team that builds Satkosia builds that one too.

**Salary**

Commensurate with experience and project exposure. Accommodation support available for outstation candidates.

**How to Apply**

Send your updated resume with a brief note on your most relevant project to:

Email: pritampatnaik@suryagarden.com WhatsApp or Call: \+91 79780 61574

Please mention your total years of experience, the type of projects you have worked on, and your current notice period.

Freshers and candidates without site experience will not be considered for this role.

Pay: ₹360,000\.00 \- ₹500,000\.00 per year

* Commuter assistance
* Food provided
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

title: People Ops Intern, Litmus GCC
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
**Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible**
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

**Work on problems where software meets the real world**
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

**Have real impact, fast**
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

**Join a high\-performance team**
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic People Ops Intern to join our Talent Acquisition team for a six\-month internship. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates who are passionate about recruitment and want to gain hands\-on experience in the end\-to\-end hiring process.

* Assist in posting job openings on various recruitment platforms.
* Support recruitment drives, campus hiring initiatives, and walk\-in interviews when required.
* Prepare recruitment reports and maintain hiring metrics.
* Assist with employer branding initiatives and recruitment\-related events.
* Perform other HR and recruitment\-related administrative tasks as assigned.


**What You’ll Bring**
**Must Have**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong interest in Talent Acquisition and Recruitment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
* Positive attitude, eagerness to learn, and a proactive approach.


**Nice to Have**
* Basic understanding of recruitment lifecycle and HR processes.
* Experience in conducting campus activities, student leadership, or organizing events.
* Knowledge of MS Excel functions

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Product Development**
-----------------------


**Overview**
  

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to design, develop, and deliver actionable analytics for a cloud\-native US
  

Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform. This role focuses on data analysis, BI, dashboards, automation, and
  

reporting across Claims, Prior Authorization, Scheduling, Coding, Collections, Payments, Denials, AR, and EDI. You will work
  

closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, DBA, AI/ML, RPA, DevOps, Compliance, and Operations teams to deliver
  

real\-time, secure, and compliance\-ready analytics.


**Job Roles \& Responsibilities**
=================================


Data Analysis \& Reporting
  

 Analyze operational, financial, and clinical data across RCM workflows to provide actionable insights.
  

 Write advanced SQL queries and generate reports from SQL Server, Snowflake, and Redshift.
  

 Develop Power BI dashboards and reports for internal teams and external stakeholders.
  

 Leverage Excel, Power Query, pivot tables, and formulas for deep\-dive analysis.
  

 Prepare stakeholder\-ready PowerPoint presentations and Word documentation summarizing trends and insights.
  

AI/ML \& Automation Enablement
  

 Collaborate with AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, and RPA teams to provide curated datasets for model training and
  

validation.
  

 Build dashboards tracking predictive insights, AI model outputs, and automation exceptions.
  

 Enable actionable insights to trigger operational workflows through Power Automate and enterprise automation.
  

RCM \& EDI Analytics
  

 Work with Claims, Prior Authorization, Coding, Collections, Payments, Denials, AR, and EDI (837, 835, 270/271,
  

276/277, 278\) data to deliver operational intelligence.
  

 Conduct root\-cause analysis to identify revenue leakage, payer performance issues, and process inefficiencies.
  

Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement
  

 Partner with Product Managers, Operations, Finance, and AI/ML teams to align analytics with business goals.
  

 Support self\-service analytics adoption for operational and management teams.
  

 Communicate insights effectively using data storytelling, dashboards, and presentations.
  

Data Governance \& Compliance
  

 Ensure analytics solutions comply with HIPAA, SOC 2, and internal security policies.
  

 Implement role\-based access controls (RBAC), PHI masking, and audit\-ready reporting.
  

 Document data sources, metrics definitions, and reporting logic to maintain traceability.
  

**Experience**:
  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
  

 3–6\+ years of experience in data analysis, BI, or analytics roles.
  

 Hands\-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL Server, Snowflake, Redshift.
  

 Strong proficiency in Excel, Power Query, pivot tables, formulas, and PowerPoint presentations.
  

 Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, or RPA\-driven analytics is a plus.
  

 Experience in US Healthcare, RCM, or other regulated domains is preferred.
  

**Technical Expertise:**
  

 Databases \& Querying: SQL Server, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL, Advanced SQL
  

 BI \& Visualization Tools: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Power Automate
  

 RCM \& EDI Analytics: 837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278
  

 AI/ML \& Automation: Dashboarding for model outputs, predictive analytics, RPA workflow monitoring
  

 Cloud Awareness: AWS, Azure, GCP (analytics \& security awareness)
  

 Data Governance \& Security: HIPAA, SOC 2, RBAC, PHI masking, audit\-ready reporting
  

 Office Productivity: Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word, including pivot tables, formulas, dashboards, and
  

presentations
  

 Integration \& Pipelines: Microservices, APIs, event\-driven data pipelines


**Skillset**:
  

 Strong data analysis, problem\-solving, and visualization skills.
  

 Ability to translate complex RCM workflows, AI outputs, and analytics into actionable insights.
  

 Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including AI, RPA, DevOps, and product.
  

 Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  

 Attention to detail, compliance awareness, and audit\-ready reporting mindset.
  

**Strategic Impact**:
  

 Deliver accurate and actionable analytics to improve operational efficiency, collections, and payer transparency.
  

 Support AI/ML adoption and automation workflows with curated data and performance dashboards.
  

 Enable real\-time insights and data\-driven decision\-making across RCM modules.
  

 Improve operational KPIs, reduce revenue leakage, and strengthen compliance and audit readiness.

Accounts Receivable Executive is responsible for all aspects of credentialing and re\-credentialing of health care professionals. **Internship Opportunity: QA Intern (Manual Testing \+ Automation \+ UI Development)**

**Location:** Remote (Work From Home)  
**Working Hours:** Full\-Time (8 Hours/Day)  
**Stipend:** Performance\-Based (To be decided after successful completion of the first 3 months)  
**Eligibility:** Freshers or candidates looking for internship

**Apply Now:** Send your resume to **career@sutramsolutions.in**

**About Sutram Solutions**

Sutram Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an early\-stage startup building AI\-powered Educational ERP and Learning Management Systems (LMS). Our mission is to transform educational institutions through intelligent automation, seamless digital experiences, and scalable technology.

We are looking for highly motivated **QA F**reshers who are passionate about software quality, eager to learn modern testing methodologies, and interested in gradually growing into UI development using **Angular or React**.

This internship is designed for freshers who are willing to work on real\-world projects while learning industry\-standard development and testing practices.

Internship Overview

During the **first three months**, your primary responsibility will be **Quality Assurance (QA)** activities. You will work closely with our development and product teams to ensure the quality, stability, and reliability of our applications.

Alongside your QA responsibilities, you will receive structured training in **Angular or React** to prepare you for future UI development responsibilities.

Primary Responsibilities

Manual Testing

* Execute manual testing for web applications.
* Validate functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Perform regression, smoke, sanity, integration, and exploratory testing.
* Verify UI consistency across browsers and devices.
* Validate end\-to\-end business workflows.

Automation Testing

* Learn and execute automation testing under mentor guidance.
* Write and maintain automation test scripts.
* Execute automated test suites.
* Identify and report automation failures.

API Testing

* Perform REST API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Validate request and response payloads.
* Verify API authentication, status codes, and business logic.

Database Validation

* Execute SQL queries for backend validation.
* Verify database records after application transactions.
* Validate data integrity and consistency.

Bug Reporting \& Tracking

* Create detailed bug reports with reproducible steps.
* Track defects using JIRA.
* Retest resolved issues.
* Work closely with developers throughout the defect lifecycle.

UI Validation

* Verify responsive layouts.
* Validate UI components against design requirements.
* Test cross\-browser compatibility.
* Ensure consistent user experience.

Documentation

* Prepare test cases and test scenarios.
* Maintain test execution reports.
* Document defects clearly.
* Share daily status reports.
* Maintain QA documentation.

Learning \& Development

Along with project work, you will receive structured training in:

* Angular or React
* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* Git
* UI Development Best Practices

The objective is to gradually prepare you for UI development responsibilities while building a strong foundation in Quality Assurance.

Daily Responsibilities

You will be expected to:

* Attend daily Scrum meetings.
* Participate in Sprint Planning.
* Participate in Sprint Reviews.
* Participate in Sprint Retrospectives.
* Update JIRA tasks regularly.
* Share daily work updates.
* Coordinate with developers, product owners, and mentors.
* Complete assigned tasks within committed timelines.
* Continuously learn and improve technical skills.

Work Commitment this is a **full\-time remote internship**.

We expect interns to:

* Commit **8 working hours per day**.
* Be available during official working hours.
* Attend all scheduled meetings without exception.
* Respond promptly to team communications.
* Maintain professionalism while working remotely.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Demonstrate discipline, consistency, and accountability.

This internship is intended for candidates who are serious about building a long\-term career in software development and quality assurance.

Skills We're Looking For

* Basic understanding of software testing concepts.
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Basic programming knowledge (JavaScript or Java preferred).
* Familiarity with SQL is an advantage.
* Understanding of REST APIs is a plus.
* Knowledge of Git is beneficial.
* Strong analytical and logical thinking.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Willingness to learn.
* Positive attitude.
* Attention to detail.

Freshers are encouraged to apply.

Selection Process telephonic **interview 1 rounds**

Upon successful completion of the **first 3 months**, you will receive:

* Experience Certificate
* Letter of Recommendation (based on performance)
* Practical experience on real\-world enterprise applications
* Hands\-on exposure to Agile methodology
* Mentorship from experienced professionals
* Exposure to Manual Testing
* Automation Testing
* API Testing
* Database Validation
* JIRA
* Scrum Process
* UI Development (Angular or React)

Future Opportunity , Interns who demonstrate:

* Strong technical growth
* Excellent performance
* Professionalism
* Ownership
* Consistency
* Team collaboration

May be invited to continue working with Sutram Solutions. Based on your overall performance after the initial three months, the company may consider:

* Extending the internship
* Offering a performance **based stipend**
* Providing additional responsibilities in UI Development
* Considering you for future full\-time opportunities

Continuation with the company will be entirely performance\-based.

**Interested?**

Discover the opportunity to join a dynamic, and responsible company that fosters the development of
  

all its people and communities around the world. Every day, we challenge employees to achieve more
  

and experience exciting careers.

  

  

**JOB PROFILE:**  

  

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Cloud IoT Engineer to join our engineering team. The candidate
  

will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable cloud\-based IoT
  

platforms for industrial applications. The role involves building multi\-tenant IoT systems, backend services,
  

real\-time telemetry pipelines, cloud APIs, and interactive dashboards on AWS while ensuring secure,
  

reliable, and high\-performance solutions.

 Proven ability to design, build, and deploy scalable, multi\-tenant IoT platforms and real\-time telemetry systems.


 Expertise in backend API development, cloud deployment strategies, and building scalable backend systems.


 Experience in UI/UX dashboard design and developing complex industrial IoT monitoring applications.  

  



**Technical Expertise (Platforms, Languages \& Protocols)**  



 Cloud Platforms: Deep hands\-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.

 Languages \& Backend Technologies: Proficiency in Node.js, Python, or Java. Optional experience with Microservices
  

architecture and containerization (Docker).


 API \& Communication: Skilled in designing and implementing REST APIs and WebSockets.


 IoT Communication Protocols: Strong knowledge of MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, and WebSocket protocols. Experience in
  

architecting MQTT broker solutions (e.g., using HiveMQ or EMQX).


 Databases: Experience with MongoDB and relational databases like MSSQL or MySQL.


 Security: Solid understanding of Authentication \& Authorization principles.


 Frontend and UI/UX technologies: React, Flutter, or Angular.  

  



**Key Deliverable / Project Experience (Not mandatory but better to have)**  



 Development of a Multi\-tenant IoT platform on AWS.

 Creation of a Real\-time energy monitoring platform.

title: Data Engineer (Snowflake + Azure Databricks + dbt/Matillion)
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven
 **Data Engineer** 
 to join our growing Data Engineering practice. The ideal candidate will be proficient in building scalable, high\-performance data transformation pipelines using
 **Snowflake, Azure Databricks, and dbt** 
 , and will thrive in Techdome's fast\-paced, client\-facing consulting environment. In this role, you will be instrumental in ingesting, transforming, and delivering high\-quality data to enable data\-driven decision\-making across our clients' organizations — owning your deliverables like a true Tech Doctor.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, configure, and optimize ingestion, transformation, and orchestration workflows using Matillion DPC where applicable.
* Design and implement scalable ELT pipelines using dbt on Snowflake, following industry\-accepted best practices.
* Build and maintain data processing workloads on Azure Databricks (PySpark/Spark SQL), including notebooks, jobs, Delta Lake tables, and Lakehouse/medallion architectures.
* Build ingestion pipelines from various sources including relational databases, APIs, cloud storage, and flat files into Snowflake and Databricks (Delta Lake).
* Implement data modelling and transformation logic to support layered architecture (staging, intermediate, and mart layers, or medallion architecture) to enable reliable and reusable data assets.
* Leverage orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt Cloud, Azure Data Factory, or Databricks Workflows) to schedule and monitor data pipelines.
* Apply dbt best practices: modular SQL development, testing, documentation, and version control.
* Perform performance optimizations in dbt/Snowflake/Databricks through clustering, query profiling, materialization, partitioning, caching, and efficient SQL/Spark design.
* Apply CI/CD and Git\-based workflows for version\-controlled deployments.
* Take complete ownership of assigned pipelines and deliverables — from design through production support — in line with Techdome's ownership culture.
* Contribute to Techdome's internal knowledge base of dbt macros, Databricks patterns, conventions, and testing frameworks; participate in internal tech talks and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and data architects across onshore and offshore teams to understand requirements and deliver clean, validated datasets.
* Write well\-documented, maintainable code using Git for version control and CI/CD processes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives.
* Support consulting engagements through clear documentation, demos, and delivery of client\-ready solutions that reflect Techdome's commitment to excellence.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1 to 4 years of experience in data engineering roles, with 6\+ months of hands\-on experience in Snowflake and dbt.
* Mandatory: Hands\-on experience with Azure Databricks — developing and deploying pipelines using PySpark/Spark SQL, Delta Lake, notebooks, clusters, and Databricks Workflows/Jobs in a production environment.
* Hands\-on experience with Matillion Data Productivity Cloud (Matillion DPC) for data ingestion, transformation, or orchestration.
* Experience building and deploying dbt models in a production environment.
* Expert\-level SQL and strong understanding of ELT principles; strong understanding of ELT patterns and data modelling (Kimball/Dimensional preferred).
* Familiarity with data quality and validation techniques: dbt tests, dbt docs, etc.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, and deployment workflows in a team setting.
* Familiarity with orchestrating workflows using tools like dbt Cloud, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or Databricks Workflows.


 Core Competencies
   

  

 Data Engineering and ELT Development
   

  

* Building robust and modular data pipelines using dbt and Databricks.
* Writing efficient SQL and PySpark for data transformation and performance tuning in Snowflake and Databricks.
* Managing environments, sources, and deployment pipelines in dbt.


 Cloud Data Platform Expertise
   

  

* Strong proficiency with Snowflake: warehouse sizing, query profiling, data loading, and performance optimization.
* Strong proficiency with Azure Databricks: cluster configuration and sizing, Delta Lake optimization (OPTIMIZE, Z\-ORDER, vacuum), Unity Catalog basics, and Spark job tuning.
* Experience working with cloud storage (Azure Data Lake, AWS S3, or GCS) for ingestion and external stages.


 Technical Toolset
   

  

* Python / PySpark: For data transformation, notebook development, and automation on Databricks.
* SQL: Strong grasp of SQL for querying and performance tuning.


 Best Practices and Standards
   

  

* Knowledge of modern data architecture concepts including layered architecture (staging → intermediate → marts) and Lakehouse/Medallion architecture.
* Familiarity with data quality, unit testing (dbt tests), and documentation (dbt docs).


 Security \& Governance
   

  

* Understanding of access control within Snowflake (RBAC) and Databricks (Unity Catalog/workspace permissions), role hierarchies, and secure data handling.
* Familiarity with data privacy policies (GDPR basics) and encryption at rest/in transit.


 Deployment \& Monitoring
   

  

* Version control using Git; experience with CI/CD practices in a data context.
* Monitoring and logging of pipeline executions, alerting on failures.


 Soft Skills — The Techdome Way
   

  

* Ownership mindset: take full responsibility for your work, from problem diagnosis to production delivery.
* Client\-first communication: ability to present solutions confidently and handle client demos and discussions.
* Collaboration: work closely with onshore and offshore teams of analysts, data scientists, and architects — every voice is heard and respected.
* Ability to document pipelines and transformations clearly.
* Basic SSIS and Matillion.
* Comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities, and fast\-changing client environments — we move fast and adapt faster.
* Passion for continuous learning and knowledge sharing (tech talks, meetups, internal upskilling).


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience in client\-facing roles or consulting engagements.
* Exposure to AI/ML data pipelines and feature stores.
* Exposure to MLflow for basic ML model tracking (native to Databricks).
* Experience/exposure using data quality tooling.
* Certifications such as Snowflake SnowPro, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, or dbt Certified Developer are a plus.


 Why Join Techdome?
   

  

* Work on high\-impact projects for global clients — from startups to Fortune 500 enterprises — across diverse industries.
* Be part of an inclusive culture that promotes open communication, teamwork, and respect for every voice.
* Grow with a company that invests in your professional development through mentorship, tech events, and hands\-on exposure to cutting\-edge data and AI technologies.
* Join a journey driven by insight and innovation — where we don't just solve problems, we push the boundaries of technology.

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an ML Forecasting Engineer to design, evaluate, and monitor predictive models that support high\-impact, data\-driven decision workflows. The role focuses on forecasting, scoring, ranking, model explainability, validation design, drift detection, and evaluation systems. The ideal candidate can translate ambiguous business questions into reliable machine learning designs while keeping privacy, bias, fairness, and model risk visible.

**Education Qualification**
 Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in a Data Science/ Artificial Intelligence/ Computational Mathematics/ Statistics or related field.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Strong practical experience with forecasting, predictive modeling, ranking, scoring, or applied machine learning systems.
* Good understanding of backtesting, holdout design, validation methodology, calibration, and drift detection.
* Ability to reason about feature quality, leakage, proxy features, bias, explainability, and model monitoring.
* Experience working with structured, time\-series, geospatial, marketplace, operational, or behavioral datasets.
* Working knowledge of production ML workflows, evaluation harnesses, model observability, and reproducible experimentation.

**Responsibilities**
* Design predictive models for forecasting, scoring, ranking, and decision\-support use cases.
* Define feature families across structured, temporal, operational, behavioral, geographic, and external data sources without exposing sensitive implementation details.
* Build backtesting, holdout, and validation strategies that measure model quality before deployment.
* Develop evaluation plans covering accuracy, calibration, ranking quality, stability, data freshness, and business usefulness.
* Design explainability approaches so product, business, and governance stakeholders can understand model outputs and drivers.
* Monitor deployed or production\-bound models for drift, degraded performance, data quality issues, and changing cohort or regional patterns.
* Identify and reduce risks from data leakage, proxy variables, privacy\-sensitive features, bias, and unfairness across cohorts or regions.
* Partner with data, product, platform, and governance teams to make models reliable, auditable, and production\-ready.

Job Purpose

The Spares Executive is responsible for the efficient management of the automobile spare parts inventory, ensuring optimum stock levels, and facilitating seamless parts distribution to both the internal service workshop and retail customers. The primary objective is to minimize vehicle turnaround time (TAT) while maintaining high inventory accuracy and minimizing dead stock.

Key Performance Areas (KPAs) \& Responsibilities1\. Inventory Control \& Warehouse Management

* Supervise the receiving, unloading, and inspection of all incoming spare parts shipments from the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) or authorized distributors.
* Ensure accurate binning and labeling of parts based on sequential codes, part numbers, and fast/slow\-moving categories.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification, cycle counts, and reconciliation against the inventory management system.

2\. Workshop \& Service Support

* Efficiently issue required parts, lubricants, and accessories to technicians against valid job cards to ensure smooth workshop operations.
* Identify and track back\-ordered or out\-of\-stock items, escalating critical shortages to the management for expedited procurement.
* Handle the processing of warranty claims for defective components and manage the storage and return of scrap parts as per OEM guidelines.

3\. Front Counter Sales \& Customer Relations

* Assist retail walk\-in clients and commercial buyers with parts identification, price quotes, and billing.
* Advise customers on product features, compatibility, and availability to maximize counter sales revenue.

4\. Administrative Compliance \& Reporting

* Maintain up\-to\-date documentation including Purchase Orders (POs), Delivery Challans, Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs), and sales invoices.
* Prepare weekly/monthly inventory reports, tracking critical metrics like dead stock, fast\-moving items, and order fulfillment rates.

title: Industrial Safety Officer
description:
**Job Purpose**

To ensure a safe, healthy, and compliant working environment by implementing and monitoring Environment, Health \& Safety (EHS) systems, reducing accidents, ensuring statutory compliance, and building a strong safety culture across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Safety Management**

* Implement and enforce safety policies, procedures, and standard operating practices.
* Conduct daily safety inspections of shop floor, machines, material handling, and work areas.
* Ensure machine guarding, PPE usage, lock\-out/tag\-out (LOTO), and safe work practices are followed.
* Identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions and take immediate corrective action.
* Lead accident prevention programs and safety campaigns.

**2\. Accident \& Incident Management**

* Investigate all accidents, near misses, and dangerous occurrences.
* Prepare accident investigation reports with root cause analysis and corrective action plans.
* Coordinate with HR, Production, and Legal teams in case of serious accidents.
* Maintain accident and incident records as per statutory requirements.

**3\. Statutory \& Legal Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with:
* Factories Act
* State Safety Rules
* ESI, Workmen Compensation
* Fire \& Emergency regulations
* Maintain all statutory registers, safety records, and inspection reports.
* Coordinate with Factory Inspector, Fire Department, and other authorities.

**4\. Safety Training \& Awareness**

* Conduct safety induction for new employees, contract workers, and visitors.
* Organize periodic safety training programs for operators, supervisors, and managers.
* Conduct tool box talks and safety briefings.
* Create awareness on machine safety, electrical safety, fire safety, and emergency response.

**5\. EHS Systems \& Audits**

* Develop and maintain EHS management systems and SOPs.
* Conduct internal safety audits and risk assessments.
* Support ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 audits (if applicable).
* Monitor compliance of contractors and vendors with safety standards.

**6\. Fire \& Emergency Preparedness**

* Maintain fire fighting equipment, emergency exits, and evacuation plans.
* Conduct mock drills and emergency response training.
* Act as key coordinator during any emergency.

**7\. Environment Management**

* Monitor waste disposal, hazardous material handling, and pollution control.
* Ensure compliance with environmental regulations.
* Coordinate with Pollution Control Board and waste management vendors.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of industrial safety rules and laws
* Accident investigation and root cause analysis
* Safety audit and inspection skills
* Training \& communication
* Documentation \& compliance management
* Ability to enforce discipline tactfully

**Qualification \& Experience**

* Diploma / Degree in Safety Engineering, Industrial Safety, or Environmental Engineering
* Mandatory: NEBOSH / ADIS / DIS or equivalent certification
* 3 \- 8 years’ experience in manufacturing / heavy engineering / industrial plants.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

title: Legal Officer
description:
**Job Description (JD)** 

**Position:** Legal Officer

**Department:** Legal \& Compliance  
**Reports To:** Chief Legal Officer / General Manager / Managing Director  
**Location:** As per Company Requirement  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

The Legal Officer is responsible for handling all legal matters of the organization, ensuring statutory compliance, minimizing legal risks, drafting and reviewing legal documents, coordinating litigation, and providing legal guidance to the management. The role also ensures compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Legal Documentation**

* Draft, review, vet, and negotiate contracts, agreements, MOUs, NDAs, service agreements, vendor agreements, employment agreements, lease agreements, and other legal documents.
* Ensure all agreements adequately safeguard the Company's legal interests.
* Maintain a centralized repository of all legal documents and contracts.

**2\. Litigation Management**

* Coordinate with external advocates and legal consultants.
* Prepare case files, legal briefs, and supporting documentation.
* Track the progress of ongoing litigation and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Attend court proceedings, arbitration, and legal hearings whenever required.

**3\. Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State laws.
* Monitor changes in legal and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate legal compliance with Government Departments and Regulatory Authorities.
* Maintain statutory registers and legal compliance records.

**4\. Corporate Legal Advisory**

* Provide legal opinions to Management on business decisions.
* Identify legal risks associated with business operations.
* Recommend preventive legal measures to minimize litigation.

**5\. HR \& Employment Laws**

* Advise HR on labor laws and employment\-related matters.
* Draft appointment letters, employment contracts, service agreements, indemnity bonds, confidentiality agreements, disciplinary notices, warning letters, show\-cause notices, suspension orders, termination letters, and settlement agreements.
* Handle employee disputes and labor\-related legal issues.

**6\. Intellectual Property Rights**

* Coordinate registration of trademarks, copyrights, patents, and domain names.
* Protect the Company's intellectual property rights.
* Monitor misuse or infringement of Company IP.

**7\. Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Conduct legal compliance audits.
* Develop legal compliance checklists.
* Maintain legal risk registers.
* Support internal and statutory audits.

**8\. Policy Development**

* Draft and review Company policies, SOPs, and governance documents.
* Ensure policies comply with prevailing legal requirements.
* Assist departments in implementing legal controls.

**9\. Notices \& Legal Correspondence**

* Draft legal notices, replies, affidavits, petitions, representations, and legal communications.
* Respond to Government notices and legal queries.
* Liaise with Government authorities when required.

**10\. Corporate Governance**

* Assist in Board Meeting documentation, resolutions, and legal records.
* Support corporate filings and secretarial compliance as applicable.
* Maintain confidentiality of all legal matters.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B.) – Mandatory
* Master's Degree (LL.M.) – Preferred
* Enrollment with the Bar Council will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 3–7 years of experience in Corporate Legal, Litigation, or Legal Compliance.
* Experience in IT, Software Development, Education, E\-commerce, or Corporate organizations is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Contract Law, Labour Laws, Company Law, and Commercial Laws.
* Familiarity with the Information Technology Act, 2000, Intellectual Property Laws, and Data Privacy regulations.
* Knowledge of POSH Act, Shops \& Establishments Act, Industrial Relations Code, Code on Wages, Social Security Code, and Occupational Safety, Health \& Working Conditions Code.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal documentation software.
* Ability to conduct legal research and interpret statutes.

**Core Competencies**

* Excellent drafting and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple assignments.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely review and execution of legal documents.
* Compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Reduction in legal risks and disputes.
* Timely resolution of litigation matters.
* Accuracy and quality of legal opinions.
* Contract turnaround time.
* Zero non\-compliance observations during audits.
* Timely renewal of licenses, registrations, and statutory filings.
* Effective legal support to business and HR functions.

**Working Relationships**

**Internal:**

* Managing Director
* Chief Technical Officer
* HR Department
* Finance \& Accounts
* Administration
* Business Development
* Operations
* Audit Team

**External:**

* Advocates and Legal Consultants
* Courts and Tribunals
* Government Departments
* Regulatory Authorities
* Police Authorities
* Vendors and Clients

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Safeguard the Company's legal interests and reputation.
* Maintain complete confidentiality of legal and business information.
* Support internal investigations and disciplinary proceedings.
* Conduct legal awareness and compliance training for employees.
* Assist Management in strategic legal planning and risk mitigation.
* Perform any other legal assignments entrusted by the Management from time to time.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Implementation - IT Product
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

Rippling’s Product Specialist team ensures customers see incredible business transformation through Rippling's most complex products.

  

Our engagements are consultative. Our specialists deeply understand the customers’ unique pain points, offer creative solutions, and build/set up their Rippling environment to address their needs. Hence, our specialists serve as a bridge between the customer and product teams. They are instrumental in driving adoption.

  

This role is to manage a new team of IT Specialists to drive exponential impact of LTV and adoption.

  

The ideal candidate for this role has experience leading teams, building processes and systems, driving operational rigor, implementing IT products (specifically\- Apps, MDM, Okta, Azure), and working with cross\-functional stakeholders. They must also handle ambiguity, unstructured situations, and scale while leading a team with high standards.

**What you will do**
--------------------

  

* Mentor, hire, and lead a team of product specialists.
* Drive an implementation team to successfully meet KPIs: productivity, project completions, adoption thresholds, and CSAT.
* + Continuously measure the effectiveness and quality of our IT implementations and make process improvements
* Work cross\-functionally with sales, CX, and product managers to improve adoption, retention, and LTV.
* This role requires a strong understanding of the below:
* + **MDM, Identity Management solutions, or other IT\-related solutions. Familiarity with other IT products such as Google, Azure, and Okta.**
* Lead trainings for internal and external resources to increase the overall knowledge of Rippling’s IT products
* Actively contribute to the development of Rippling’s IT Products through collaboration with sales, product and engineering
* + Regularly coordinate with product and engineering teams to fix bugs and launch new features
	+ Serve as a connector between engineering, product, and other customer\-facing teams
* Organize beta programs and support GTM efforts for IT product launches

**What you will need**
----------------------

  

* 6\+ years of experience implementing IT products (prior management experience is strongly preferred)
* Strong prioritization and time management
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by a fast\-paced environment and excited to build
* Data and process\-centric leader with attention to detail and the ability to solve complex, interdependent problems
* Experience in growing teams with a learning mindset, people\-first attitude, and strong sense of responsibility for your domain
* Able to work with cross\-functional leaders to drive improvements to product and processes

**Note**
--------

* **This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out of our Bangalore office three days a week.**
* **This job requires you a t****o work in the EST shift.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

  

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com


Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

description:
**Junior Quality Engineer**

**Department:** Quality Assurance (QA/QC)  
**Designation:** Junior Quality Engineer  
**Industry:** Ductile Iron Pipe (DIP) Manufacturing

Job Summary

The Junior Quality Engineer is responsible for monitoring and maintaining quality standards throughout the Ductile Iron Pipe (DIP) manufacturing process. The role involves inspecting raw materials, in\-process products, and finished pipes to ensure compliance with **IS 8329, ISO 2531, EN 545, EN 598**, customer specifications, and company quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Incoming Material Inspection

* Inspect incoming raw materials, ferro alloys, cement, zinc, bitumen, and other consumables.
* Verify supplier quality certificates and test reports.
* Ensure material conformity with approved specifications.

In\-Process Quality Control

* Monitor quality parameters during:
* Melting
* Centrifugal Casting (CCM)
* Annealing
* Finishing
* Zinc Coating
* Cement Mortar Lining (CML)
* Hydrostatic Pressure Testing (HPTM)
* Conduct visual inspections to identify casting defects, cracks, blowholes, shrinkage, and surface imperfections.
* Verify socket and spigot dimensions using standard measuring instruments.

Finished Product Inspection

* Inspect finished DI pipes before dispatch.
* Verify:
* Pipe dimensions
* Wall thickness
* Length
* Socket and spigot profiles
* Zinc coating thickness
* Cement mortar lining quality
* External coating quality
* Pipe marking and traceability

Testing \& Measurement

* Perform dimensional inspection using:
* Vernier Calipers
* Micrometers
* Ultrasonic Thickness Gauges
* Measuring Tapes
* Go/No\-Go Gauges
* Assist in hydrostatic pressure testing verification.
* Coordinate laboratory testing for mechanical and chemical properties.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain inspection reports and quality records.
* Prepare Daily Quality Reports (DQR), rejection reports, and NCRs.
* Record customer complaints and corrective actions.
* Support internal and external quality audits.

Quality Improvement

* Identify process deviations and quality issues.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
* Coordinate with Production and Maintenance teams to reduce defects and improve product quality.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives.

Safety \& Compliance

* Follow plant safety rules, PPE requirements, and quality procedures.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 Quality Management System and company standards.
* Maintain housekeeping in inspection areas.

Qualification

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Metallurgical, Production, or Materials Engineering.

Experience

* **0–3 Years** in Ductile Iron Pipe Manufacturing.
* Freshers with relevant internships or industrial training in a DI Pipe Plant may also be considered.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of Ductile Iron Pipe Manufacturing Process.
* Quality Inspection Techniques.
* Understanding of IS 8329, ISO 2531, EN 545, and EN 598 standards.
* Ability to read engineering drawings.
* Familiarity with measuring instruments.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* CAPA Documentation.
* MS Excel \& Quality Reporting.
* Good communication and teamwork.

Equipment \& Instruments Used

* Vernier Caliper
* Micrometer
* Ultrasonic Thickness Gauge
* Height Gauge
* Measuring Tape
* Go/No\-Go Gauges
* Hydrostatic Test Equipment
* Coating Thickness Gauge
* Hardness Tester

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* First Pass Quality (FPY)
* Customer Complaint Reduction
* Rejection Rate
* Rework Reduction
* Inspection Accuracy
* On\-Time Inspection Completion
* Audit Compliance
* CAPA Closure Effectiveness

Reporting To

Candidates with experience in **Ductile Iron Pipe Manufacturing Plants only** will be preferred, particularly in quality inspection of:

* Melting

Ability to handle disputes, own escalations end\-to\-end, and drive resolution with professionalism and accountability Ability to manage multiple senior stakeholders and a high volume of concurrent requisitions across levels without loss of quality or turnaround. Ability to work well in a team, mentor peers, and collaborate effectively across geographies and functions. Strong written and verbal communication skills to influence candidates, hiring managers, and leadership. Advanced Excel proficiency for reporting, dashboards, pivots, lookups, and pipeline analytics. Team management and stakeholder management orientation with proven ownership of outcomes, SLAs, and hiring KPIs. .Experience of managing job boards, sourcing platforms, and vendor / RPO coordination including SLA and commercial governance. Advanced proficiency in the English language to draft crisp candidate communications, leadership updates, and hiring notes. Analytical mindset to solve increasingly complex problems and take decisions with minimal instruction, using data and market insights. description:
:

India is among the top ten priority markets for General Mills, and hosts our Global Shared Services Centre. This is the Global Shared Services arm of General Mills Inc., which supports its operations worldwide. With over 1,300 employees in Mumbai, the center has capabilities in the areas of Supply Chain, Finance, HR, Digital and Technology, Sales Capabilities, Consumer Insights, ITQ (R\&D \& Quality), and Enterprise Business Services. Learning and capacity\-building is a key ingredient of our success.
Job Description:  

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one other and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.  



**OVERVIEW**


The Digital and Technology team at General Mills stands as the largest and foremost unit, dedicated to exploring the latest trends and innovations in technology while leading the adoption of cutting\-edge technologies across the organization. Collaborating closely with global business teams, the focus is on understanding business models and identifying opportunities to leverage technology for increased efficiency and disruption. The team's expertise spans a wide range of areas, including AI/ML, Data Science, IoT, NLP, Cloud, Infrastructure, RPA and Automation, Digital Transformation, Cyber Security, Blockchain, SAP S4 HANA and Enterprise Architecture. The MillsWorks initiative embodies an agile@scale delivery model, where business and technology teams operate cohesively in pods with a unified mission to deliver value for the company. Employees working on significant technology projects are recognized as Digital Transformation change agents.

  



The team places a strong emphasis on service partnerships and employee engagement with a commitment to advancing equity and supporting communities. In fostering an inclusive culture, the team values individuals passionate about learning and growing with technology, exemplified by the "Work with Heart" philosophy, emphasizing results over facetime. Those intrigued by the prospect of contributing to the digital transformation journey of a Fortune 500 company are encouraged to explore more details about the function through a provided Link.

 **Purpose of the role:**


The Digital and Technology team of General Mills India Centre is looking for a passionate and enthusiastic individual to contribute to the Global Digital Transformation initiative at General Mills in capacity of a D\&T Analyst II – Data Stewardship. This role will report into Sr. D\&T Manager \- Data Stewardship, GDGS team in India and functionally collaborate with stakeholders (business and technical teams) across the Enterprise teams. This individual will develop and support the data policies, processes, rules and standards for our Unstructured data (documents, emails, media files, PDFs, social media, chat logs, etc.) across the enterprise. The Unstructured Data Steward has ownership and accountability for executing data governance processes and standards for the Unstructured data.

 **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Lead Data Governance initiatives within the Unstructured data space.
* Develop and maintain a governance framework for unstructured data including ownership, security, access, retention, lineage, and quality monitoring.
* Support configuration and roll out of new software solution for managing Unstructured data.
* Partner with data owners to classify and tag unstructured content using metadata and assisted tools.
* Establish audit methodology and remediation approach.
* Identify and inventory unstructured data sources across business units (SharePoint, network drives, email archives, Microsoft teams, etc.)
* Work across functions to classify, catalog, label and govern unstructured content, ensuring it is discoverable, secure, and used responsibly in compliance with enterprise data policies and regulatory frameworks.
* Collaborate with different functions and stakeholders (including Cyber Security, Office 365 and Governance) to drive adherence to Unstructured Data Policy and standards.
* Partner with the data cataloging team to integrate unstructured data assets into the Enterprise Data Catalog.

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree
* **Experience:** 10\+ years (2\+ years of relevant experience preferred).

 **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in Unstructured Data Governance
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive change with cross functional stakeholders.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience and competence in leading, influencing, coaching and mentoring others
* Self\-starter and self\-motivated requiring little support from others
* Proactive and tech savvy.
* Experience with software applications configurations, managing configurations settings, troubleshooting issues.
* Attention to detail with the ability to identify patterns and inconsistencies
* Tenacity to find and resolve issues
* Demonstrated knowledge of Data Governance strategies and processes.
* Experience with Collibra, Alation, and/or other data governance solutions

title: Director of AI & Digital Design-D
description:

Area of Expertise: Product Development \& Management

Reference Code: JR\-0000120265


  
**Role and Responsibilities:**


* Set the HR AI and automation strategy, translating enterprise AI direction into a clear HR roadmap linked to HR strategy, enterprise transformation, scaled automation, agentic delivery and personal productivity.
* Define and evolve the HR AI architecture in partnership with Enterprise Architecture, CDO, Digital Channels, HR Technology and control functions, ensuring solutions are coherent, governed, reusable and aligned to the wider technology landscape.
* Own the AI vendor strategy for HR, shaping how platforms such as Microsoft, Workday and ServiceNow are used as part of a joined\-up approach.
* Surface, shape and challenge vendor AI roadmaps, ensuring emerging capabilities are understood early and aligned to Barclays’ architecture, priorities and risk appetite.
* Act as a visible enterprise leader for AI in HR, building confidence and momentum by connecting strategy to tangible use cases, scaled enablement and measurable outcomes.
* Define and drive the AI adoption model across HR, separating broad colleague adoption from targeted “power user” enablement and scaling both effectively.
* Build capability across HR, improving AI literacy, confidence and practical application at all levels.
* Design and operationalise AI governance for HR, setting clear guardrails for risk, ethics, data use and controls while enabling delivery pace.
* Act as the link into enterprise AI governance, translating central standards into practical, usable guidance for HR teams.
* Bring hands\-on technical credibility, working closely with delivery teams to understand code, data, orchestration and design, and challenge decisions to avoid over\-engineered or fragmented solutions.
* Partner with the Foundry and Federated AI teams, where they lead build and run, while this role owns use case definition, AI patterns and reuse across HR.
* Bring forward new AI use cases and reusable patterns, testing, proving and scaling them across HR.
* Identify and drive reuse of AI components and patterns, reducing duplication and accelerating scale.
* Act as the primary interface into the Portfolio Office, improving the quality, consistency and alignment of AI demand into prioritisation and funding decisions.

* Drive execution through clear operating rhythms, governance and decision points to convert ideas into live services and sustained value.

* Development of concepts and specifications which define features, functionalities, target market, user interface, technical specifications and potential revenue models of new products.
* Evaluation of the technical feasibility, legal compliance, and potential risks associated with the development and launch of the new product.
* Monitoring of market trends and analysis feedback from internal employees and target customers through prototypes, user testing sessions, and beta programs to identify areas for improvement to refine the product before launch.
* Management of comprehensive launch plans and technical deployments for products that establish rollout timelines, marketing strategies, training initiatives and communication channels to promote the launch new products effectively.
* Monitoring of key metrics such as adoption rates, usage patterns, customer satisfaction, and revenue generation to assess the product's performance against set goals.

**Director Expectations**


* To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
* They manage the direction of a large team or sub\-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
* Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub\-function.

RINA is currently recruiting for a **Senior Talent Recruiter** to join its office in Mumbai within the **Global Human Resources** Division.


**Mission**
-----------


The Senior Recruiter, under the direction of and in collaboration with the local Head of Human Resources/Recruitment, is responsible for creating and delivering all facets of recruiting success throughout the organization. This will be achieved through the development of local and national recruiting plans, employing traditional sourcing strategies and resources as well as developing new, creative recruiting strategies.

  

\#LI\-KS1


**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------


1\. Strategic Planning:
  

* Contribute to the development of long\-term talent acquisition strategies in alignment with the company's business goals.
* Collaborate with senior management to understand organizational needs and create recruitment plans that support strategic objectives.

2\. Client Relationship Management:
  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal clients, including hiring managers and department heads, to better understand their staffing needs and provide strategic recruiting solutions.

3\. Project Management and recrutment process:
  

* Lead and manage recruitment projects, ensuring they are executed efficiently and effectively.
* Create, manage, and coordinate full cycle recruitment process for engineering, and other professional positions.
* Consult with Hiring Managers to create profiles and post requisitions.
* Use social media, association job boards, and networking to recruit candidates.
* Maintain all pertinent applicant and interview data in applicant tracking system.

4\. Market Intelligence:
  

* Conduct in\-depth market research to stay ahead of industry trends, salary benchmarks, and competitor practices, providing valuable insights to inform recruitment strategies.
* Attend campus recruiting events, manage internship and co\-op programs, and other activities.

5\. Process Improvement:
  

* Identify opportunities for process optimization within the recruitment function and lead initiatives to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Implement best practices and continuously evaluate and refine recruitment processes.
* Educate managers on hiring for attributes, behaviors, and technical skills.

6\. Quality of Hire:
  

* Focus on the quality of candidates hired, ensuring they align with the company's values, culture, and long\-term goals.
* Implement methodologies to measure and improve the success and retention of hires.

7\. Talent Pipelining:
  

* Develop and maintain a talent pipeline for critical roles, proactively identifying and engaging with potential candidates to ensure a steady stream of qualified talent.

8\. Collaboration with HR Leadership:
  

* Collaborate with the HR leadership team to ensure alignment of recruitment strategies with broader human resources initiatives.
* Contribute to workforce planning and talent management discussions.

9\. Performance Metrics and Reporting:
  

* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for the recruitment team and regularly report on metrics, providing insights into recruitment effectiveness.

10\. Employer Branding and External Relations:
  

* Play a key role in enhancing the employer brand, both internally and externally.
* Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to attract top talent and strengthen the organization's reputation.

11\. Regulatory Compliance:
  

* Stay informed about changes in labor laws and regulations related to recruitment and ensure compliance in all recruitment activities.

12\. Leadership and Mentorship:
  

* Provide leadership and guidance to junior recruiters, sharing expertise, and mentoring them in the recruitment process.
* Act as a subject matter expert, offering insights into industry trends, best practices, and effective recruiting strategies.

**Education**

Bachelor’s Degree in Economics or Psychology

description:
Finance Manager

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 6–10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to lead our Finance \& Accounts function. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end accounting, financial reporting, taxation, statutory compliance, budgeting, MIS, cash flow management, finance automation, and internal controls. This role requires a proactive professional who can build scalable finance processes and support business growth.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end accounting operations including General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Banking, Payroll, Fixed Assets, and Financial Closing.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly, and annual closure of books.
* Handle GST, TDS, Income Tax, ROC, Professional Tax, and other statutory compliances.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly MIS reports, financial statements, and management dashboards.
* Lead budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning, and working capital management.
* Perform daily revenue reconciliation, bank reconciliation, and payment settlement reconciliation.
* Drive finance process automation and ERP integration to improve efficiency.
* Develop and strengthen internal controls, SOPs, and audit readiness.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, banks, and other stakeholders.
* Support management with financial analysis, business planning, and strategic decision\-making.

Required Qualifications

* CA (Inter), CA, CMA, MBA (Finance), M.Com, or equivalent qualification.
* 6–10 years of Finance \& Accounts experience.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading a Finance or Accounts team.
* Strong knowledge of Accounting, GST, Direct Taxation, Companies Act, and statutory compliances.
* Hands\-on experience with Tally Prime, Zoho Books, Busy, SAP Business One, or similar ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong analytical, communication, and leadership abilities.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates from **Retail, FMCG, Distribution, Manufacturing, Logistics, Vending, or other high\-volume transaction businesses** will be preferred. Experience with payment gateway reconciliations and finance automation will be an added advantage.

title: HUMAN RESOURCES (HR) MANAGER / HR LEAD
description:
**About**
 The HR Manager will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling the human capital function at Red Balloon Aerospace. This role goes beyond traditional HR administration and plays a strategic role in talent acquisition, performance management, compliance, culture building, and organizational development for a high\-growth aerospace startup. The HR Manager will work closely with founders, technical leaders, and finance to ensure the right talent, systems, and culture are in place to support innovation, execution, and long\-term growth.
   

  

**Description**
 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

 ‚\- Strong interpersonal and communication skills
   

  

 ‚\- Ability to work hands\-on and independently
   

  

 ‚\- High integrity and confidentiality ‚\- Startup mindset with problem\-solving attitude
   

  

 ‚\- Excellent organizational and documentation skills
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Comfort working with engineers, scientists, and technicians
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 \| Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Own end\-to\-end recruitment for engineering, operations, R\&D, manufacturing, interns, and business roles
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Develop hiring plans aligned with program milestones and funding stages
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Build strong campus, research institute, and internship pipelines
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Coordinate interviews, offers, onboarding, and background verification
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support hiring of consultants, advisors, and contractual staff
   

  

 \| HR Operations \& Compliance
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Establish HR policies, SOPs, and employee handbook
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Ensure compliance with Indian labour laws, PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops \& Establishments Act
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Manage employment contracts, NDAs, IP agreements, and exit formalities
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, and payroll coordination
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Liaise with auditors, legal, and finance teams on HR matters
   

  

 \| Performance Management \& Employee Development
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Design and implement performance appraisal systems (OKRs/KPIs) should have knowledge on HR tools such as Zoho People, Zoho Recruit, Zoho Payroll.
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Drive goal setting, reviews, feedback cycles, and promotions
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Identify training needs and coordinate technical \& leadership development programs
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support career path planning for engineers, technicians, and managers
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Digitize and automate attendance, leave, onboarding, payroll inputs, exits, and document management
   

  

**‚Ä¢ Own HR MIS Reporting, Including**
* Headcount \& attrition reports
* Hiring funnel \& time\-to\-hire metrics
* Compensation \& cost\-to\-company (CTC) summaries
* Performance and productivity dashboards


 ‚Ä¢ Provide regular HR dashboards to founders, leadership, and investors
   

  

 \| Culture, Engagement \& Employer Branding
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Build a strong startup culture aligned with Red Balloon's mission and values
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Drive employee engagement initiatives, town halls, and internal communication
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Promote a safety\-first, ethics\-driven, and innovation\-focused work environment
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support diversity, inclusion, and merit\-based growth
   

  

 \| Compensation, Benefits \& ESOP Management
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Design competitive compensation structures aligned with startup benchmarks
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support ESOP policy implementation and employee communication
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Manage benefits including insurance, reimbursements, and statutory benefits
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Assist founders in workforce cost planning and budgeting
   

  

 \| Strategic HR \& Scaling Support
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Act as a strategic HR partner to founders during scale\-up phases
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Support organizational design as teams grow (structure, roles, reporting)
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Prepare HR systems for audits, investor diligence, and government programs
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Enable smooth transition from early startup to structured growth stage
   

  

 DESIRED
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ 2\-5 years of HR experience (startup, manufacturing, aerospace, deep\-tech preferred)
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and HR compliance
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Proven experience in recruitment, HR operations, and performance management
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Experience working in fast\-growing or founder\-led organizations
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Strong interpersonal and communication skills
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Ability to work hands\-on and independently
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ High integrity and confidentiality
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Startup mindset with problem\-solving attitude
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Excellent organizational and documentation skills
   

  

 ‚Ä¢ Comfort working with engineers, scientists, and technicians
