title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Role Summary:** 




 The role is responsible for partnering with business functions and departments to establish HR as a strategic enabler by ensuring timely manpower support, effective talent engagement, and efficient workforce management across locations. It focuses on attracting, hiring, and retaining an engaged workforce to support the achievement of HR and organizational objectives.
 



  





 The position also aims to enhance overall HR effectiveness by planning and implementing relevant HR policies, programs, and practices. Additionally, it involves identifying, innovating, and deploying appropriate regional HR interventions that align with the organization’s HR strategy and contribute to improved business performance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





**Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner with hiring managers to identify and attract top talent.
* Forecast future manpower needs and ensure timely resource availability.



  





**Business Partnership** 



* Act as a strategic partner to the leadership team by aligning people strategy with business goals.
* Understand business model, targets, and market dynamics to provide proactive HR solutions.
* Support organizational design, role structuring, and manpower planning to drive business performance.



  





**Performance \& Productivity** 



* Drive the performance management process for the location team—goal setting, reviews, and feedback.
* Collaborate with leaders to identify top performers and manage performance gaps.
* Track productivity metrics and contribute to incentive design and recognition programs.



  





**Employee Engagement \& Culture** 



* Build a high\-performance and engagement\-driven culture among the location workforce.
* Design and implement engagement activities suited for a field\-based and target\-driven team.
* Be the employee advocate—ensuring strong communication, feedback mechanisms, and grievance handling.



  





**HR Operations \& Compliance** 



* Ensure smooth execution of HR policies, compensation, and benefits for the organization.
* Maintain data accuracy, reports, and compliance with labour and company policies.



  





**Qualifications** 



* MBA / PGDM with 4 \- 6 years of experience in HR or related field
* Strong organization, communication and conflict resolution skills
* Demonstrated ability to onboard new employees and manage HR tasks
* Proficient in Microsoft Office suite

We are looking for ambitious individuals who are eager to build a career in the startup and investment ecosystem.

description:
FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We are a dynamic team of engineers, researchers, and domain experts who build advanced signal processing solutions for **Defence, Aerospace, and Research applications**. Our work spans high\-performance communication systems, Telemetry Receivers, Radar Processing, and mission\-critical signal processing platforms. We focus on solving complex real\-world problems by developing state\-of\-the\-art DSP algorithms and high\-performance implementations for RF, FPGA, Embedded Processors, and high\-speed computing platforms.


#### **About the role**



We are looking for a Sr. Algorithm Developer – DSP who can design, analyze, and implement advanced signal processing algorithms from first principles. This role requires strong theoretical foundations in DSP and communications, along with the ability to translate research literature (IEEE papers, standards, and technical publications) into working algorithms and optimized implementations. The role also involves studying existing algorithms and improving their performance, robustness, and computational efficiency for real\-world deployment.



The candidate will work on communication and radar signal processing algorithms including modulators, demodulators, synchronization techniques, channel coding, detection, estimation, and performance optimization.

  



#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Study and derive algorithms from **IEEE papers, research publications, standards, and technical documentation**.
* Develop DSP algorithms for **Digital Communication systems and Radar Signal Processing**.
* Design algorithms for:
	+ Modulation \& demodulation (PCM/FM, SOQPSK, CPM, QPSK, QAM etc.)
	+ Synchronization (carrier, symbol, timing recovery)
	+ Channel coding \& decoding (LDPC, Turbo, Reed\-Solomon, etc.)
	+ Filtering, estimation, and detection algorithms
	+ Radar signal processing techniques
* Implement algorithms using MATLAB / Python for modelling and simulation.
* Convert algorithms into high\-performance implementations in C/C\+\+ or FPGA\-friendly architectures using RTL.
* Validate algorithms through simulation, mathematical analysis, and test data.
* Analyze existing algorithm implementations and improve:
	+ Accuracy
	+ Computational efficiency
	+ Latency
	+ Robustness in real\-world conditions
* Optimize algorithms for hardware acceleration platforms (FPGA/GPU/embedded processors).
* Work closely with FPGA, embedded software, and RF teams to integrate algorithms into system\-level designs.
* Support testing, debugging, and performance evaluation of deployed systems.
* Participate in technical problem solving and architectural discussions.
* Document algorithms, simulation results, and performance evaluations.
* Stay updated with latest developments in signal processing and communication theory.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering from a reputed institution.
* 4–8 years of experience in system development involving both software and hardware components.
* Strong understanding of DSP, RF systems, and communications/radar technologies.
* Proficiency in one or more tools/languages: LabVIEW, C/C\+\+, MATLAB, Verilog/VHDL.
* Experience managing small technical teams and working in cross\-functional setups.
* Familiarity with projects involving government agencies or DRDO is a plus.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills for client and internal reporting.
* Strong fundamentals in:
	+ Digital Signal Processing
	+ Digital Communications
	+ Probability \& Random Processes
	+ Estimation Theory

#### **Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time position, located at our Hyderabad office, with regular on\-site visits to clients and vendor locations.

#### **Why join US?**


* Culture of Excellence: We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* Opportunities for Growth: We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

title: Software Support Executive
description:
**About the Role :**

This role is ideal for freshers or early\-career professionals who communicate well in writing, enjoy solving problems, and want to build a career in customer support and SaaS. Full product training is provided, so prior experience is welcome but not required.

Because you speak with customers all day, you will also have the chance to earn performance incentives \- by recommending useful upgrades and add\-ons and by referring new leads \- on top of your fixed salary.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Respond to customer queries over live chat promptly, professionally, and with a friendly tone.
* Understand each customer’s problem, troubleshoot it, and guide them to a clear solution.
* Manage several chat conversations at the same time without letting quality slip.
* Escalate complex or technical issues to the relevant team and follow up until they are resolved.
* Spot opportunities to recommend relevant upgrades or add\-ons (cross\-sell and upsell) during conversations, and encourage referrals \- passing qualified leads to the sales team.
* Meet response\-time, resolution\-time, and customer\-satisfaction (CSAT) targets.
* Record conversations accurately and keep customer information up to date.
* Share recurring problems and customer feedback with the product and support teams.
* Help improve our help center by suggesting or drafting support articles.

**Required Skills (Must\-Have) :**

* **Strong English communication is mandatory** \- clear written English with correct grammar, spelling, and a warm, professional tone.
* Good typing speed and accuracy (around 35\-40 words per minute or higher).
* Strong reading comprehension to quickly understand what a customer needs.
* A patient, empathetic, and customer\-first attitude.
* Ability to multitask and stay organized while handling multiple chats.
* Comfort using computers and web\-based applications.
* A quick learner who can pick up our product and processes.
* Fresher to 1 year of experience (customer support internships count).

**Good to Have :**

* Familiarity with SaaS products, especially HRMS, Payroll, or related domains.
* A natural ability to notice customer needs and suggest the right solution (helpful for cross\-sell, upsell, and referral incentives).
* Ability to communicate in Hindi or other regional languages.
* Any prior customer support, BPO, or internship experience.

**What We Offer :**

* **Performance incentives** for cross\-sell, upsell, and new lead referrals \- in addition to your fixed salary.
* Structured onboarding and full product training \- no prior experience needed.
* A supportive team and a clear path to grow into senior support, QA, or customer success roles.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Engineer I (QA)
description:
At Aristocrat, we are dedicated to crafting world\-class gaming experiences that deliver happiness to millions of players worldwide. As we keep innovating and raising standards in the gaming sector, we seek driven and passionate people to join our team. This opportunity is outstanding for those eager to be part of a dynamic and inclusive culture promoting collaboration and creativity. As an Engineer I (QA), you will have a key role in guaranteeing the flawless delivery of our games and supporting our mission to provide high\-quality, entertaining slot games on advanced platforms.
   

  

 What You'll Do
 * Test C\+\+ based Class 2 games (US and RSA), HHR \& NYL games across various kinds of gaming hardware/cabinets.
* Ensure high\-quality standards of games are delivered around the world.
* Collaborate with developers and other QA engineers to identify and resolve defects.
* Build, maintain, and complete test plans and test cases.
* Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionalities remain unaffected by new developments.
* Report and document bugs and issues, providing detailed information for the development team.
* Participate in code reviews to provide insights on potential quality issues.
* Analyze game performance and identify areas for improvement.
* Assist in the development of automated test scripts to increase testing efficiency.
* Stay updated with the latest industry trends and testing methodologies.


 What We're Looking For
 * Between 1\-2 years of experience in software testing, ideally within the gaming sector.
* Proficiency in testing C\+\+ based applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and dedication to quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with various testing tools and methodologies.
* Experience with automated testing is a plus.
* A passion for gaming and a keen interest in game development.


 Join us at Aristocrat, where your skills and passion for quality will thrive in an encouraging and innovative environment. We look forward to welcoming you to our team and achieving new heights together!
   

  

 Why Aristocrat?
   

  

 Aristocrat is a world leader in gaming content and technology, and a top\-tier publisher of free\-to\-play mobile games. We deliver great performance for our B2B customers and bring joy to the lives of the millions of people who love to play our casino and mobile games. And while we focus on fun, we never forget our responsibilities. We strive to lead the way in responsible gameplay, and to lift the bar in company governance, employee wellbeing and sustainability. We’re a diverse business united by shared values and an inspiring mission to bring joy to life through the power of play.
   

  

 We aim to create an environment where individual differences are valued, and all employees have the opportunity to realize their potential. We welcome and encourage applications from all people regardless of age, gender, race, ethnicity, cultural background, disability status or LGBTQ\+ identity. EEO M/F/D/V
 * World Leader in Gaming Entertainment
* Robust benefits package
* Global career opportunities


 Our Values
 * All about the Player
* Talent Unleashed
* Collective Brilliance
* Good Business Good Citizen


**Travel Expectations**
 None
   

  

**Additional Information**
*At this time, we are unable to sponsor work visas for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the job posting location for this position on a full\-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship.*

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About Astound Digital**
 At Astound Digital, we are pioneers in the digital landscape, dedicated to transforming how the world interacts with technology, data, and creativity. Our role as trusted advisors in the digital landscape empowers the world’s most innovative brands with frictionless, end\-to\-end customer experiences. We are known for our comprehensive solutions, proven expertise, and collaborative, nimble approach that instills confidence in our clients. We embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to drive innovation, efficiency, and better outcomes for our clients and employees. Join us to navigate and lead in the ever\-changing digital world, where your impact will extend beyond the ordinary.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 As a QA Engineer, you will be an integral member of a high\-performance, feature\-driven team dedicated to ensuring the quality and reliability of complex eCommerce solutions. You will be responsible for the full testing lifecycle, from analyzing intricate business requirements to executing detailed test cases and verifying critical bug fixes. Your role is essential in maintaining the high standards required for enterprise\-level digital products, working collaboratively across technical teams to mitigate risks. By providing proactive recommendations and ensuring flawless third\-party integrations, you will help deliver seamless and high\-quality digital experiences for our global clients.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Analyze complex business requirements to design, document, and execute comprehensive test cases that ensure product integrity.
* Identify, report, and track software defects within bug\-tracking systems, ensuring thorough verification of all fixes.
* Provide accurate effort estimations for individual features and assigned tasks to support project planning and timelines.
* Actively participate in daily project meetings and brainstorming sessions to address technical issues and quality risks.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional project teams to maintain a unified approach to quality assurance.
* Conduct rigorous integration testing for third\-party services and external components within the eCommerce ecosystem.
* Propose improvements for QA\-related procedures, tools, and systems to the QA Lead and Project Managers.
* Maintain clear and consistent reporting on test results and overall product quality status for internal stakeholders.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 3 years of professional software testing experience with a strong theoretical foundation in QA methodologies.
* Proven experience in requirement analysis, test case creation, and comprehensive reporting of test results.
* Hands\-on expertise with bug\-tracking systems and a deep understanding of the defect lifecycle.
* Intermediate English communication skills, both spoken and written, for effective collaboration in a global environment.
* Demonstrated ability to test third\-party integrations and complex web\-based applications.
* Proficiency in estimating testing efforts for specific features or individual task loads.
* Strong team player with the ability to adapt quickly to changing project needs and dynamic environments.
* Familiarity with tools such as Postman, JIRA, Confluence, or JMeter is highly desirable.


 What we offer in return
   

  

* Global Collaboration: The opportunity to work daily with diverse and talented professionals across the globe.
* Off\-the\-Charts Career Growth: Сlear career path and a performance review system, career coaching, training and certifications, mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* Well\-being Is Top Priority: Parental leave, paid time off, comprehensive health and medical plans.
* Real Work\-Life Balance: Dependent on location, we offer remote, in\-office, or hybrid working modes; flexible hours; work\-life balance support on every stage and level.


 Why work for Astound Digital?
   

  

 Whether you’re working directly with our world\-renowned clients or with your Astound colleagues from around the globe, you will shape the future of digital commerce, using emerging technologies and innovative approaches.
   

  

**Grow your career with Astound Digital, and discover exciting opportunities while doing the work you love!**

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
description:

We are looking for a passionate and enthusiastic **Junior DevOps Engineer (Fresher)** to join our team. This role is ideal for recent graduates or candidates starting their DevOps career. You will receive hands\-on training while working with Linux servers, cloud platforms, web hosting, CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools. A strong willingness to learn and solve technical problems is essential.### **Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in configuring SSL certificates, DNS, and email services.
* Learn CI/CD concepts and deployment automation.
* Perform server updates, backups, and routine maintenance.
* Troubleshoot basic server, website, and network issues.

* Document technical procedures and deployment processes.

* GitHub Actions or Jenkins

* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines

### **What We Offer**

* Structured training and mentorship from senior DevOps engineers.
* Hands\-on experience with live production servers and cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to AWS, Docker, CI/CD, Linux administration, and monitoring tools.
* Opportunities to work on real\-world projects.
* Career growth into DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).
* Support for technical learning and certifications.

* **Employment Type:** Full\-time
* **Location:** On\-site

This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates who are enthusiastic about working with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, embedded systems, IoT devices, sensors, automation, and hardware integration.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on real\-world IoT projects involving hardware prototyping, firmware development, sensor integration, communication protocols, cloud connectivity, device testing, and deployment. This role provides hands\-on experience in building intelligent connected devices for industrial, healthcare, smart building, and enterprise automation applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and program applications for Arduino and Raspberry Pi platforms.
* Configure and integrate IoT devices with various sensors and actuators.
* Interface hardware modules such as relays, displays, cameras, motors, RFID, GPS, and GSM modules.
* Develop firmware for microcontrollers using C/C\+\+ and Python.
* Design and implement communication between IoT devices and cloud platforms.
* Configure and troubleshoot hardware peripherals and embedded systems.
* Build prototypes for automation, monitoring, and control systems.
* Work with communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP, TCP/IP, UART, SPI, and I2C.
* Connect IoT devices with REST APIs and cloud services.
* Test, debug, and optimize embedded applications.
* Collaborate with software, AI, and hardware teams.
* Document hardware configurations, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
* Learn new embedded technologies and contribute to innovative IoT solutions.

**Eligibility**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or a related field.
* Good understanding of embedded systems and IoT concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Familiarity with Arduino and Raspberry Pi through academic or personal projects.
* Basic electronics knowledge, including circuits, sensors, and microcontrollers.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

* **Strong programming skills** in **C, C\+\+, and Python**, with basic knowledge of **Shell Scripting** (preferred).
* **Embedded systems development** using **Arduino, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, and ESP8266**, with expertise in **Embedded C, GPIO, interrupts, PWM, timers, and serial communication**.
* **Hands\-on experience with sensors, hardware, and communication protocols**, including **temperature, humidity, PIR, ultrasonic, gas, light, pressure, accelerometer/gyroscope, RFID, GPS, GSM/4G, camera modules, motors, relays, LCD/OLED displays**, and protocols such as **UART, SPI, I2C, MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, Bluetooth, and Wi\-Fi**.

* **Basic understanding of advanced embedded and IoT concepts**, including **Home Automation, Industrial IoT, Robotics, Smart Devices, Embedded Linux, Edge Computing, Computer Vision on Raspberry Pi, and AI on Edge Devices**.

title: Senior RF Design Engineer +
description:
FOR TECH ENTHUSIASTS, INNOVATORS \& VISIONARIES
At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting\-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission\-critical applications.


#### **About the role**



As a Senior RF Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in the architecture, design, simulation, implementation, bring\-up, and verification of RF and microwave hardware subsystems for aerospace and defence applications.



The role includes RF signal\-chain design from antenna port to baseband, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution, and wideband RF front\-end modules operating up to 40 GHz. The engineer will translate system\-level requirements into circuit\-level specifications and support the complete hardware development cycle from concept to qualification and production support.



#### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Circuit Design \& Analysis**
	+ Design and optimize RF/microwave circuits and subsystems, including LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, RF switches, attenuators, VCOs, PLLs, frequency synthesizers, clock/LO distribution circuits, and RF front\-end modules up to 40 GHz.
	+ Perform RF system and circuit\-level analysis, including link budget, cascaded gain/noise figure, IP2/IP3, P1dB, dynamic range, SFDR, phase noise, jitter, LO leakage, image rejection, harmonic/spurious analysis, EVM, and emissions performance.
	+ Develop and execute RF simulation models using tools such as Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent tools for linear, nonlinear, EM, and system\-level co\-simulation.
	+ Select and qualify active/passive RF components and design with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
	+ Define component derating, worst\-case analysis, lifecycle risk, alternate part strategy, and reliability considerations for high\-reliability aerospace and defence hardware.
	+ Translate system\-level requirements such as frequency range, sensitivity, output power, EVM, phase noise, isolation, spur level, and dynamic range into verifiable RF circuit and subsystem specifications.
* **Systems Architecture \& Integration**
	+ Contribute to RF subsystem architecture trade studies and module\-level implementation planning.
	+ Lead antenna\-to\-baseband RF signal\-chain design for radar, EW, telemetry, tactical radio, SDR, wideband receiver, and up/down\-converter applications.
	+ Work with system engineers to allocate RF performance budgets and cascade gain, noise figure, linearity, filtering, isolation, and dynamic range from antenna port to ADC/DAC interface.
	+ Define LO and clock architecture, including reference clock distribution, PLL/synthesizer selection, phase noise budgeting, spur management, synchronization, and frequency settling requirements.
	+ Guide and review RF PCB layout, including stack\-up selection, controlled impedance routing, RF via transitions, grounding, return\-current paths, shielding, cavity isolation, connector transitions, and mixed\-signal partitioning.
	+ Support mechanical and thermal integration, including RF shielding, heat sinking, enclosure effects, RF cable/connector selection, vibration considerations, and high\-power PA thermal design.
	+ Support integration with FPGA, firmware, embedded software, and DSP teams from the RF hardware side, including AGC, DPD, calibration, JESD204/LVDS interfaces, timing, synchronization, and hardware control interfaces.
* **Product Development \& Qualification**
	+ Define and execute RF test plans covering conducted and radiated measurements, including S\-parameters, gain, gain flatness, return loss, output power, P1dB, IP3, noise figure, phase noise, EVM, ACLR/ACPR, harmonic/spurious emissions, receiver sensitivity, blocking, isolation, and EMI/EMC pre\-compliance.
	+ Perform prototype bring\-up, lab debugging, tuning, rework support, failure analysis, oscillation/debug, spur hunting, desense investigation, thermal drift analysis, and simulation\-to\-measurement correlation.
	+ Support design readiness and qualification activities for MIL\-STD\-461 EMC and MIL\-STD\-810 environmental requirements.
	+ Support production transfer, including DFM/DFT review, BOM alternate qualification, test fixture definition, production test procedures, and yield/debug support.
	+ Maintain design documentation, including schematics, RF PCB specifications, simulation reports, test procedures, test reports, analysis reports, interface control documents, compliance matrices, and verification evidence.
	+ Prepare and present PDR/CDR material, technical status, risk items, and design trade\-off summaries to program managers, internal teams, and external customers.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* B.Tech / M.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or closely related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on RF/microwave circuit and subsystem design experience in an aerospace, defence environment
* Demonstrated proficiency with at least two RF EDA tools: Keysight ADS, AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, or equivalent.
* Strong command of RF test equipment: VNA, Spectrum Analyzer, signal generator, noise\-figure Analyzer, Oscilloscope and power meters.
* Experience designing with GaN/GaAs/SiGe/CMOS RFIC/MMIC devices.
* Familiarity with MIL\-STD\-461, MIL\-STD\-810, and MIL\-HDBK\-217 requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce and defend technical documentation in a program environment


**Preferred**  




* M.S. or Ph.D. in RF / Microwave Engineering or related discipline
* Experience with Radar, Electronic warfare (EW), or Telemetry systems
* Familiarity with VHDL/Verilog or Python/MATLAB for test automation and signal processing support.


#### **Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time position located at our Hyderabad office, with regular on\-site visits to clients and vendor locations.
* Overtime may be necessary to ensure the timely delivery of client projects.
* Weekend work is uncommon but may occasionally be required.

* **Culture of Excellence:** We are committed to fostering a culture where every individual can thrive, grow, and make a difference.
* **Opportunities for Growth:** We believe in investing in our people and providing opportunities for professional development and advancement.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Join a collaborative and supportive work environment where your contributions are valued and recognized.
* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a team that thrives on innovation and is committed to pushing the boundaries of RF technology.

title: iti electrician
description:
**Job Title:** ITI Electrician  
**Department:** Life Science  
**Location:** \[Company Location]  
**Reporting To:** Electronics Engineer / Department Head

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dedicated **ITI Electrician** to support the **Life Science Department** in the assembly, wiring, testing, installation, and maintenance of laboratory and scientific equipment. The ideal candidate should possess sound electrical knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and a commitment to quality and safety.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform electrical wiring and assembly of laboratory and life science instruments.
* Read and understand electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and circuit layouts.
* Install and connect electrical components such as switches, relays, power supplies, sensors, MCBs, and control panels.
* Conduct functional testing and electrical inspection of equipment before dispatch.
* Troubleshoot and repair electrical faults in laboratory equipment and machines.
* Assist in the installation, commissioning, and servicing of equipment at customer sites when required.
* Carry out preventive maintenance to ensure equipment reliability and performance.
* Maintain daily work records, testing reports, and service documentation.
* Ensure compliance with company quality standards, electrical safety practices, and 5S procedures.
* Coordinate with the Production, Mechanical, Quality, and Service teams for smooth project execution.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and assist in new product development activities.

**Qualification**

* ITI in **Electrician** (NCVT/SCVT).
* Freshers or candidates with **1–3 years of experience** are welcome to apply.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of electrical wiring and industrial electrical systems.
* Ability to read electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
* Hands\-on experience with multimeters, crimping tools, and other electrical testing instruments.
* Basic understanding of electrical panels, sensors, SMPS, relays, and motors.
* Good troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and quality.
* Willingness to travel for installation and service assignments, if required.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in laboratory equipment, life science instruments, medical devices, automation systems, or pharmaceutical equipment will be an added advantage.

Pay: ₹8,338\.82 \- ₹29,964\.30 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sr Administrator (Support & Operations)
description:
Madurai, Tamil Nadu
  
Job Summary
  
  

1\. Role Overview The Problem Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end lifecycle of Problem Records, driving root cause analysis (RCA), preventing recurrence of incidents, coordinating cross functional teams, and ensuring continuous service improvement across the IT landscape. They serve as a technical, analytical, and governance leader within ITSM.
  
  

2\. Key Responsibilities
  
  

A. Problem Lifecycle Ownership • Own and manage the full lifecycle of all Problem Records from creation to closure. • Review, evaluate, accept or reject new problem submissions.
  
  

B. Root Cause Analysis (RCA) \& Corrective Actions • Conduct and lead RCA for all high severity incidents. • Use standard RCA methods such as 5 Whys (mandatory) and Fishbone Analysis. • Ensure implementation of CAPA (Corrective \& Preventive Actions) to eliminate root causes.
  
  

C. Stakeholder Coordination • Form, lead, and facilitate cross functional investigation teams with internal teams \& vendors. • Host weekly governance calls with technical tracks to drive updates and resolve bottlenecks. • Engage with customer teams for RCA walkthroughs, EMT forums, and approvals.
  
  

D. Process Compliance \& Audit • Ensure strict adherence to the Problem Management process and organizational SLAs. • Conduct periodic audits, publish findings, and drive closure of non compliance gaps.
  
  

E. Documentation \& Reporting • Document RCA in approved templates (FOP, 5W1H, etc.) and upload within SLA. • Maintain Known Error Database (KEDB) and ensure updates are reflected in ITSM tool. • Prepare and present monthly performance dashboards to leadership \& customers.
  
  

F. Proactive Problem Management • Perform trend analysis to identify repeating patterns, environmental risks, and improvement areas.
  
  

* Recommend preventive measures to avoid recurrence of incidents.


G. Collaboration With Incident \& Change Teams
  
  

* Validate that incidents triggering problem records follow correct routing.
* Work with Change Management to validate if incidents are triggered by changes.
* Raise PTasks when fixes, validations, or reviews are required.


3\. Skills \& Competencies \- Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong knowledge of ITIL v4 Problem Management and related ITSM processes.
* Proficiency in RCA methods: 5 Whys, Fishbone, and failure analysis.
* Good understanding of Incident \& Change Management touchpoints.


Analytical \& Governance Skills
  
  

* Strong decision making and analytical capability.
* Ability to manage cross functional collaboration and multi vendor environments.


Tools Knowledge
  
  

* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow/Vanilla).
* Good working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint for reporting and presentations.


Communication \& Leadership
  
  

* Excellent communication skills for leading RCA calls and governance meetings.
* Ability to handle customer escalations and drive discussions across support tracks.


4\. Responsibilities for Senior/Lead Problem Manager
  
  

* Oversee adherence of the Problem Management process across the engagement.
* Govern proactive problem management initiatives and trend reviews.
* Manage EMT forums (Executive Management Team) for RCA approvals.
* Mentor Problem Managers and regulate their investigation quality.


5\. Additional Expectations
  
  

* Ability to work 24/5 support model (if applicable)
* Ensure excellent customer experience and CSAT outcomes.
* Participate in hiring, interviews, and training new analysts


Key Responsibilities
  
1\. To adhere to quality standards, regulatory requirements and company policies.
  
2\. To provide support for complex incidents, escalated by analysts, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions to resolve technical \& security issues.
  
3\. To work on value adding activities such Knowledge base update \& management, training freshers, coaching analyst.
  
4\. To resolve complex tickets within agreed SLAs and collaborate with other support teams to ensure seamless operations \& security posture.
  
5\. To ensure positive customer experience and CSAT through First Call Resolution , minimum rejected resolutions / reopen Cases and mitigating security threats.

title: Lead Administrator (Tools & Automation)
description:
Madurai, Tamil Nadu
  
Job Summary
  
  

Configuration Manager Role Summary
  
  

The Configuration Manager is responsible for managing, controlling, maintaining, and ensuring the accuracy of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and all Configuration Items (CIs). The role provides critical configuration data to enable effective Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management and ensures integrity of IT asset and service configuration throughout the lifecycle.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

1\. CI \& CMDB Governance• Identify and manage configuration structures for all infrastructure CIs, including CI ownership, relationships, and configuration documents.• Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the CMDB, ensuring all teams comply with configuration policies and procedures.• Use discovery tools to identify and correct CI attributes, and reconcile discrepancies with operations teams.
  
  

2\. Configuration Lifecycle Management• Manage CI lifecycle stages such as request, procurement, receipt, inventory, deployment, decommissioning, retirement, and disposal.• Ensure all changes to CIs are controlled through the Change Management process, enforcing data integrity and version tracking.
  
  

3\. Tooling, Process Support \& Improvements• Plan and manage support for Service Asset \& Configuration Management (SACM) tools and processes.• Maintain and enhance the configuration management system to securely store CI data and provide accurate, timely information.• Monitor performance and capacity of the CMDB and recommend improvement opportunities.
  
  

4\. Data Quality \& Reporting• Review results of discovery scans, analyze missing CI attributes, and work with operations teams for remediation.• Provide accurate configuration data to enable timely decision making for all ITSM processes.• Produce and publish CMDB accuracy reports and health metrics.
  
  

5\. Cross Process Alignment• Support Incident, Problem, Change, and Release teams by ensuring reliable configuration information.• Improve service quality by maintaining categorized, accurate configuration data that helps streamline troubleshooting, impact analysis, and root cause identification.
  
  

Required Skills \& Qualifications
  
  

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of CMDB concepts, CI attributes, CI relationships, and service mappings.• Experience using discovery tools, SACM platforms, and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).• Understanding of IT infrastructure components (servers, network devices, applications, databases).Process \& ITIL Skills• Deep knowledge of ITIL Service Asset \& Configuration Management (SACM).• Ability to work closely with Change, Incident, Problem, Release, and Asset Management functions.• Strong analytical skills for CI data reconciliation and configuration audits.


Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and coordination skills to work with operations teams and stakeholders.• Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.


Key Responsibilities
  
1\. To champion ITIL, security, and data privacy to offer high\-quality, well\-documented solutions, minimizing risks and maximizing customer satisfaction.
  
2\. To provide support for complex incidents, escalated by analysts, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions to resolve technical \& security issues.
  
3\. To work on value adding activities such as maintainenace of a comprehensive Knowledge base , act as a mentor to junior analysts,and deliver training programs for freshers, equipping them with essential skills to become productive .
  
4\. To contribute to a positive customer experience and high CSAT scores by providing fast, accurate, and secure resolutions, fostering customer trust and satisfaction.
  
5\. To proactively identify and address potential security vulnerabilities to protect customer data and prevent security incidents.

title: Manager - Medical Science
description:
**Title:** **Manager \- Medical Science**
=========================================

Date: Jul 10, 2026
Location: Sun House \- Corporate Office
Company: Sun Pharma Laboratories Ltd
**Job Title:**  


Manager \- Medical Science**Business Unit:**  

**MACR**  

**Location:**  


Mumbai  


At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you **“Create your own sunshine”**— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?  



As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self\-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”  


**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Medical monitoring activity which includes eligibility assessment based on inclusion, exclusion criteria and detailed medical history, review of study endpoint data review and safety investigations.
* Preparation of synopsis, protocol, Clinical Study Report (CSR) and present the proposals in subject’s expert committee (SEC) regulatory meeting.
* Collaborate with clinicians, KOL to get the feedback and inputs on clinical trial design, comparator and endpoints of the study to finalize synopsis.
* Review of patient eligibility and approval of patients through Interactive Response Technology (IRT) system
* Work with data management team to review timely data extract and participate in data cleaning activities to ensure timely database lock and release of tables, figures, and listings (TLFs).
* Training the study team on protocol and applied aspect of the protocol to clarify the relevance and criticality of each activity considering the study endpoints.
* Interact with investigator to resolve the queries related with protocol from the sites and Ethics Committee.
* Review of AE and SAEs forms and provide review comments in timely manner
* Medical writing of scientific documents
Planning publications activities for clinical journal manuscripts, clinical journal abstracts, and study article. Identify additional clinical data analysis in collaboration with statistics team and subsequently submission and present the data in scientific forums  
* 
  

**Job Requirements**  


**Educational Qualification**  


MBBS \+MD (Pharmacology)  


**Experience**  


1 \-2 years previous work experience.  


**Skills required include:**  


* MD (Pharmacology) or other relevant medical qualification with 1\-2 years of relevant experience or fresher.
* Experience in working in clinical science domain working in different capacities as medical monitor for clinical trial/ medical expert for clinical development plan for products across therapies is desirable.

  


**Your Success Matters to Us**  



At Sun Pharma, your success and well\-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. *Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!*

title: Personal Assistant
description:
Job Title: Personal Assistant \& Operations Coordinator (Sales \& HR)

Role Overview

We are seeking a high\-caliber, multi\-faceted professional to serve as the right hand to our Director. This is not a traditional secretarial role; it is a strategic position that combines Executive Support, Sales Coordination, and Human Resources Management. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem\-solver who can transition seamlessly from managing the Director’s schedule to closing a sales lead or onboarding a new employee.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Executive Support (The PA Pillar)

\- Act as the primary point of contact and "gatekeeper" for the Director.

\- Manage a complex calendar, including scheduling meetings, travel arrangements, and personal errands as needed.

\- Prepare briefing documents, presentations, and reports for board\-level meetings.

\- Handle sensitive information with the utmost confidentiality.

2\. Sales \& Business Development Support

\- Lead Management: Monitor incoming leads, conduct initial follow\-ups, and qualify prospects for the Director.

\- CRM Management: Keep the sales pipeline updated and ensure all client data is accurate.

\- Client Relations: Draft proposals, send out contracts, and maintain relationships with key stakeholders to ensure project continuity.

3\. Human Resources \& Administration

\- Recruitment: Post job openings, screen resumes, and coordinate interviews for various departments.

\- Onboarding: Manage the documentation for new hires (contracts, IDs, system access) and facilitate their orientation.

\- Office Culture: Assist in managing employee records, tracking leaves, and organizing team\-building activities or internal policy updates.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

\- Experience: experienced or Fresher in an PA, Sales Support, or HR Generalist role.

\- Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to represent the Director professionally.

\- Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365/Google Workspace and experience with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) or HRIS tools.

\- Adaptability: The "startup mindset"—willingness to jump into tasks that fall outside the formal JD.

\- Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field is preferred.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided

Work Location: In person

At Constelli, we don't just build signal processing systems, we engineer the future of Defense and Aerospace technologies. If you're someone who thrives on complexity, innovation, and impact, this is where your journey begins.
We're a team of passionate engineers, researchers, and problem\-solvers driven by purpose and united by a shared vision: to develop real\-time electronically intelligent systems and advanced algorithms that empower mission\-critical platforms across India's defense ecosystem.
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
Whatever you're designing DSP algorithms, Architecting Telemetry Systems, Testing RF Platforms, or Simulating EW environment, your work at Constelli will matter. Our projects span:
Software \- defined Radar simulators.
Telemetry and Target Tracking System.
Sensor Fusion, Electronic Warfare \& AI\-enabled platforms.
Field Deployment of Critical Defense Infrastructure.
Who Thrives Here
Curious minds who go beyond job descriptions .
Engineers who love building systems from the ground up.
Innovators who turn edge cases into launchpads.
Freshers and interns from ECE/CSE/EIE backgrounds eager to learn and lead.
What You’ll Experience
End\-to\-End Ownership: From concept to deployment, your ideas take flight.
Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work shoulder to shoulder with experts in Hardware, Software, RF, and Systems Design.
Dynamic Culture: We believe great work happens when you're happy and heard.
Career Acceleration: Mentorship, real\-time feedback, and opportunities to lead from Day 1\.
  
#### **About Us**



We are a dynamic team of young engineers, domain experts, and seasoned sales professionals dedicated to providing comprehensive turnkey solutions for complex challenges in Signal Processing. Our expertise spans the cutting\-edge technologies in Signal Processing, addressing critical needs in the Defence and Aerospace sectors. Our offerings encompass a wide range of solutions, from tactical radios and radar systems to extensive research and mission\-critical applications.

  


#### **About the role**



We are looking for an experienced and driven Technical Sales Professionals to support our B2G (Business\-to\-Government) sales processes. In this customer\-facing role, you will be responsible for lead generation, technical engagement, relationship management, and sales closure. You will spend significant time interacting directly with clients at their sites, playing a critical role in identifying opportunities, understanding customer needs, and supporting proposals and bids.



#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Conduct on\-site customer meetings, presentations, and demonstrations to showcase tailored technical solutions.
* Generate new business leads through networking, industry events, and market research.
* Gather and document technical and functional requirements from customers.
* Build and nurture strong relationships with stakeholders across customer organizations.
* Manage the sales process by following up on proposals, coordinating meetings, and supporting sales closure strategies.
* Perform market and competitor analysis to support strategic decision\-making in bidding processes.
* Assist in compiling accurate and compelling technical and financial bids.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely submission of proposals and documents.
* Maintain regular CRM updates and reporting to support ongoing sales operations.
* Represent Constelli Signals at industry trade shows and defense expos as needed.

#### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics/Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering (EE/EC/EIE).
* 3–5 years of experience in the Defence sector, preferably in Radar, EW systems, and working with DRDOs, ISRO, and DPSUs.
* Strong understanding of RF systems, sub\-systems, signal processing, and FPGA programming.
* Familiarity with test and measurement equipment like Signal Generators, Analysers, and Network Analysers.
* Excellent interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, including competitor and market analysis.
* Willingness to travel extensively to customer locations across India and abroad.
* Experience with CRM tools and sales management platforms.
* A technical mindset with the ability to bridge engineering and customer requirements.

  


#### **Employee status and commitments**


* Permanent full\-time position located at our Bangalore office, with regular on\-site visits to clients and vendor locations.
* Overtime may be necessary to ensure the timely delivery of client projects.
* Weekend work is uncommon but may occasionally be required.

 Broadway is a first\-of\-its\-kind experiential retail destination that seamlessly blends commerce with culture. Designed as a physical ecosystem for digital\-first D2C brands, we bring over 200 trendsetting labels across fashion, streetwear, beauty, and wellness directly to consumers. With presence in key metro cities like Delhi, Hyderabad, Pune, and Mumbai, Broadway is more than a marketplace—it is an immersive playground featuring live events, creator studios, and community workshops that reshape the modern shopping experience.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a driven HR Intern to join our recruitment team. You will help source, screen, and select top talent for our fast\-paced retail operations. This role offers hands\-on experience in high\-volume hiring and talent acquisition strategies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, and professional networks.
* Screen resumes to match specific retail job descriptions and requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic interviews to assess candidate fit and communication skills.
* Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and hiring managers.
* Maintain and update the applicant tracking system (ATS) database daily.
* Participate in campus recruitment drives and job fairs if required.


**Requirements**
* Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed an MBA in HR.
* Experience: Prior internship experience in the retail sector is highly preferred.
* Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Tools: Basic knowledge of LinkedIn, job boards, and MS Office (Excel, Word).
* Traits: High energy, ability to multitask, and excellent time management.
* Speed: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume hiring environment.


**What You Will Learn**
* End\-to\-end recruitment cycle management.
* High\-volume hiring strategies specific to the retail industry.
* Stakeholder management and professional corporate communication.

description:
This opportunity is designed for candidates interested in understanding how modern recruitment teams identify, engage, and onboard talent at scale. Working alongside experienced hiring professionals, you will gain exposure to candidate lifecycle management, interview operations, recruitment reporting, and employer branding initiatives.
   

  

 🚀 Why This Opportunity Matters
   

  

 Talent acquisition plays a critical role in helping organizations grow by connecting the right people with the right opportunities. At Meesho, recruitment teams contribute directly to business expansion by supporting hiring initiatives across departments and ensuring a positive experience for every candidate.
   

  

 This position provides early\-career professionals with exposure to real\-world hiring processes while building transferable skills in communication, coordination, stakeholder management, and reporting.
   

  

 💼 What Your Day Could Look Like
   

  

 As part of the Talent Acquisition team, you may be involved in:
   

  

* Scheduling interviews between candidates and hiring managers
* Coordinating virtual recruitment drives and hiring events
* Assisting recruiters with candidate communication
* Supporting resume screening and application tracking
* Creating and publishing job postings
* Maintaining recruitment reports and hiring dashboards
* Updating candidate information across recruitment systems
* Ensuring a smooth and professional candidate experience


 🤝 Working With Multiple Stakeholders
   

  

 Recruitment is a highly collaborative function that requires interaction with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, employees, and external partners. Strong communication and organizational skills are valuable for succeeding in this environment.
   

  

 You will learn how recruitment teams manage multiple hiring requirements simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and professionalism throughout the process.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced
 **HR \& Administration Manager** 
 to join Crown as we establish our first manufacturing facility in
 **Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh** 
 .
 



  





 This is a unique opportunity to become one of the founding members of
 **Crown India** 
 , playing a critical role in building the organisation from the ground up. As the first HR leader on site, you will lead the creation of the HR and administration function, drive the recruitment and onboarding of our workforce, and help shape the culture, structure, and people practices that will support the long\-term success of the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 As the HR \& Administration Manager, you will be responsible for building and leading the full HR and administration function for Crown's new manufacturing facility in Lucknow. You will drive workforce planning and recruitment, establish HR policies, systems and processes, and oversee onboarding, training, performance management and employee engagement activities. As a trusted business partner to the Plant Manager, you will also lead industrial relations matters, including union engagement, grievance management and contractor oversight, while ensuring full compliance with Uttar Pradesh and Central labour legislation. In addition, you will manage payroll, compensation and benefits, HR reporting and analytics, and all site administration services including security, housekeeping, transport and vendor management.
 



  





**About You** 




 You are an experienced manufacturing HR leader with 10–15 years of progressive HR experience, including significant exposure to industrial relations, labour law compliance, payroll and workforce management within a manufacturing environment. You have a strong understanding of Uttar Pradesh and Central labour legislation, experience working with trade unions and regulatory authorities, and ideally have supported a greenfield project, site start\-up or major plant expansion. Combining strong commercial awareness with excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, you are a hands\-on, resilient professional who can build people processes from the ground up while fostering a safe, inclusive and high\-performing workplace culture.
 



  





 An MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, Industrial Relations or a related discipline is required, while additional Labour Law or Industrial Relations qualifications would be advantageous. Experience within packaging, FMCG, beverage, automotive, engineering or other manufacturing environments will be highly valued, as will fluency in both Hindi and English.
 



  





**Why Join Crown?** 




 This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact by helping launch and grow Crown's presence in India. You will have the autonomy to build the HR function from the ground up, recruit and develop a high\-performing workforce, and play a key role in shaping the culture and success of a world\-class manufacturing operation from day one.

**Location: Gurgaon, Sector 27**

**Reports To: Founder / Chief of Operations** 




  





 SuperProfile is the all\-in\-one creator store — a creator economy platform designed to help content creators, brands, and agencies grow, monetize, and manage their audience at scale. We're VC\-backed, Forbes\-recognized, and recipients of the Instagram Champion Award at Meta's WhatsApp Business Summit. With a 100\+ member team and scaling rapidly, we're building something game\-changing — and we need a seasoned HR leader who can own the entire people function, scale culture, and drive organizational excellence as we grow.
 



**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




 We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on HR Manager who will function as the Head of the People function at SuperProfile. You'll own everything people — from building scalable HR systems and leading a growing HR team, to shaping organizational culture across 100\+ employees and ensuring world\-class talent operations. This isn't a support role; it's a leadership seat at the table.
 



 We want someone who is deeply tech\-savvy, AI\-native in their approach to HR, and has ideally been through the chaos and excitement of scaling a Series A or Series B startup. **Systems Building, Tech \& AI Integration**

 • Create data\-driven hiring funnels with clear tracking — source\-to\-hire ratios, time\-to\-fill, quality\-of\-hire, and cost\-per\-hire metrics
 



**Culture, Talent \& Organizational Development** 




 • Design and implement a culture framework that is intentional, inclusive, and aligned with SuperProfile's fast\-paced, Gen Z\-friendly DNA

 • Create structured training and development programs — leadership pipelines, skill\-building tracks, and career pathing frameworks
 



 • Establish trust\-driven employee relations protocols, including grievance handling, conflict resolution, and skip\-level conversations
 



 • Drive employee engagement initiatives and conduct regular pulse checks across teams to identify gaps and opportunities
 



 • Lead DEI (Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion) efforts and ensure they are embedded into hiring, development, and day\-to\-day culture
 



**Strategic HR \& People Analytics** 




 • Partner directly with the Founder and Chief of Ops to define the long\-term HR strategy and people roadmap
 



 • Lead policy creation and rollout — leave policies, performance management frameworks, benefits design, POSH compliance, and more
 



 • Design and implement a robust performance management system with clear goal\-setting, review cycles, and feedback mechanisms
 



 • Build HR dashboards and MIS reports giving leadership real\-time visibility on people metrics — attrition, engagement, hiring velocity, cost\-per\-hire, etc.
 



 • Conduct regular analysis of team health, retention, and organizational design; present insights and action plans to leadership
 



**Compliance \& Governance** 




 • Ensure seamless statutory compliance across all entities — TDS, GST, Income Tax, labor law adherence, and audit readiness
 



 • Handle internal and external audits, secretarial processes, and regulatory filings with precision
 



 • Stay proactively updated on compliance changes and implement necessary adjustments ahead of deadlines
 



 • Establish and maintain financial policies and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements
 



**QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIREMENTS** 




**Must\-Have** 




 •
 **(mandatory)** 
 MBA in HR
 



 • 7\+ years of progressive HR experience with at least 3 years in a managerial or leadership capacity
 



 • Proven experience managing HR for teams of 100\+ employees in a high\-growth startup environment
 



 • Prior experience at a Series A or Series B startup is strongly preferred — you understand the pace, the pivots, and the controlled chaos of scaling
 



 • Strong expertise in Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, payroll management, and HR governance
 



 • Demonstrated track record of building HR functions, systems, and processes from scratch — not just inheriting and maintaining them
 



 • Tech\-savvy and tool\-first mindset — you're comfortable evaluating and implementing HRIS, ATS, payroll platforms, and productivity tools (e.g., Keka, Darwinbox, greytHR, Zoho People, or similar)
 



 • AI\-friendly and automation\-oriented — you actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, etc.) to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making in HR workflows
 



**Leadership \& Mindset** 




 • Systems thinker — you see broken processes and build scalable solutions, not band\-aids
 



 • Ownership mentality — you don't wait for permission; you identify problems and fix them
 



 • Strong leadership skills — ability to build, inspire, and manage a high\-performing HR team
 



 • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across all levels of the organization
 



 • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete data, and moving fast without compromising quality
 



 • Data\-driven decision maker — you back your recommendations with numbers, not just instinct
 



**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU** 




 • A leadership seat — you're not supporting the people function, you're owning it
 



 • Direct access to founders; your voice shapes strategic decisions and company direction
 



 • High\-impact visibility — see your work transform company culture within the first 90 days
 



 • Work at the intersection of tech and people — build AI\-powered, systems\-driven HR from the ground up
 



 • A fast\-paced, collaborative environment with massive growth and learning opportunities
 



 • A fun, creative team that values ownership, real talk, and building things that matter
 



 • Competitive compensation and benefits that match the scope of the role
 



 • Growth trajectory as SuperProfile scales — this role grows with the company

 The Employee Relations (ER) Manager will be responsible for strengthening Medline’s International employee relations framework and practice by proactively addressing workplace issues, coaching managers \& employees, ensuring legal compliance, and promoting a culture of openness and fairness.
   

  

 This role will work in close collaboration with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) across all International markets to ensure consistent, timely, and effective handling of people matters and to enable managers to build high\-performing, compliant, and engaged teams.
   

  

 The role will also be accountable for managing investigations into cases raised via EthicsPoint (Medline´s case management system for concerns raised by employees).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Employee Relations \& Compliance Management**
 Act as an advisor to local HR teams on employee relations matters and partner with HRBPs for holistic case handling. Conduct fair, thorough, and unbiased investigations into workplace concerns, escalated via EthicsPoint or through other channels, domestic enquiry, grievances, misconduct, or policy violations, in accordance with Medline policy and with adherence to principles of natural justice. Maintain detailed case documentation, track trends, and share monthly insights with internal stakeholders. Partner with Legal on cases involving significant risk and ensure preventive risk mitigation. Liaisons with corporate ER and legal team for reporting and global process alignment Support statutory and internal audits related to employee relations, disciplinary actions, and compliance processes. Monitor adherence to HR policies and escalate deviations; recommend policy upgrades as needed. Manages the templates for formal communications that are outcomes of investigations and provides coaching \& guidance for local HR to complete them appropriately, in line with local requirements Provide guidance on the consistent application of disciplinary actions, PIPs, coaching plans, and corrective processes.
   

  

**Manager \& HRBP Enablement, Culture \& Process Strengthening**
 Upskill HRBPs and investigators around the management of the International investigation processes to ensure consistency and fairness in process Work closely with HRBPs to coach managers on handling performance issues, conflict resolution, conduct concerns, and difficult conversations. Build preventive ER capability through manager training, employee awareness sessions, playbooks, checklists, and communication resources. Strengthen team\-level trust, psychological safety, and communication by identifying patterns and early\-warning indicators. Collaborate with L\&D to embed ER best practices into manager development programs, including the facilitation of upskilling sessions for HR. Support HRBPs by reviewing performance documentation, PIP design, and ensuring process robustness. Partner with the international HR leadership team to identify, analyse and action plan recurring issues across our markets as an input to our employee relations agenda Ensure transparent, consistent, and timely communication with all stakeholders on ER matters.

With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
As a member of our Talent Acquisition team, you will play a key role in shaping Riveron’s employer brand and supporting our ability to hire top talent. We are a people\-first company, focused on delivering exceptional experiences for both our candidates and our internal stakeholders.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will partner closely with recruiters, hiring teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver a high\-touch, seamless recruiting experience. This role is highly execution\-focused and detail\-oriented, with an emphasis on coordination, communication, and operational excellence. You will also gain exposure to broader recruiting strategy and have opportunities to grow your career in talent acquisition.
   

  

 This role is based in India and will support recruiting efforts across U.S. teams, requiring regular collaboration across time zones.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* 4\-6 years of experience in a coordination, administrative, or similar operational and tactical role supporting recruiting teams based in the U.S.
* Comfortable working across U.S. time zones and collaborating with global stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and follow\-through
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working in an applicant tracking system, with hands\-on experience in Ashby strongly preferred
* Demonstrated experience maintaining data integrity, governance, and reporting within an ATS (e.g., ensuring accurate candidate records, tracking pipeline data, and supporting reporting needs)
* Strong proficiency with scheduling tools, Outlook calendars, and Microsoft Office products
* High level of professionalism, accountability, and a client service mindset
* You’re looking to build a career in talent acquisition and enjoy being at the center of fast\-paced, people\-driven work
* You take pride in creating organized, thoughtful experiences and bring a strong sense of ownership to your work
* You are proactive, highly responsive, and detail\-oriented, with a focus on delivering an exceptional candidate and stakeholder experience
* You have a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, learn quickly, take initiative, and bring structure to evolving processes and changing priorities


**What You’ll Do**
* Coordinate and schedule interviews across multiple time zones, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and interviewers
* Serve as a point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, delivering a high\-touch, white\-glove experience
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date candidate data in our applicant tracking system (Ashby)
* Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to ensure smooth execution of the recruiting process, proactively following up and driving progress
* Identify opportunities to improve scheduling workflows, communication, and overall candidate experience
* Support reporting and data tracking to help drive recruiting insights and efficiency
* Assist with recruiting programs and initiatives
* Contribute to operational excellence by maintaining strong processes, documentation, and data integrity


**About Riveron**
 At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high\-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client\-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well\-being in and out of the office.
   

  

**Check Us Out On Social Media**
 LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook
   

  

*Riveron Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer and believes that we are stronger together through our diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.*
 Full time roles are eligible for a full range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, and PTO. A complete description of all available benefits can be found at Riveron's Benefits page at https://riveron.com/riveron\-life/. Contract roles are not eligible for benefits.
   

  

**Fraud Alert**
 Please beware of fraudulent schemes or impersonations when going through the job application process. A Riveron employee will never recruit via text or extend unsolicited employment offers. Additionally, a Riveron employee will never ask you to exchange money or purchase anything as part of the recruiting process.
   

  

*Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are used to support the hiring process in screening, assessing, and/or selecting applicants for this position. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance.
 



 Together, we unlock potential.
 



  





**About the role:**

* Responsible for compliance with country/jurisdiction law and regulations for business as usual and when supporting the integration and harmonisation for any Merger and Acquisition activity
* Partner with Centres of Expertise and Global HR Operations to support the execution of enterprise and business programs in the region/country, as defined in the HR Service catalogue

* Educate Country Business leaders and managers to undertake their responsibilities as defined in the HR Service Catalogue and Ways of Working



  





**Work Environment, Employee Relations and Compliance:** 




  




* Ensure the consistent practice and implementation of Employee Relation activities through the application of uniform policies, standard Operating Procedures and documented templates.
* Work with managers to provide effective coaching on managing performance and disciplinary issues, ensuring actions meet company and legislative requirements to maintain a positive and professional work environment for all colleagues
* Serve as a local resource on work/life balance issues; coordinate with managers on alternative work arrangements and lead best place to work initiatives.
* Provide case management advice on key areas such as disciplinary, performance management, redundancy, long\-term illness, and other Employee Relation issues. Provide guidance to colleagues and to people managers to ensure successful outcomes that balance risk and business cost.

* Partner with Centres of Expertise to ensure global programs are executed in line with local legislation and consultation requirements
* Utilize global HR technology, global processes and the tiered support model to support an integrated “One HR” organisation focused on the colleague and manager experience of HR services.

* Experience of managing restructuring programs and change management initiatives would be an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including a good command of English.
* The ability to interact with colleagues at all levels.
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage competing and rapidly changing priorities.
* Ability to work independently and operate well in a team.
* Understanding and experience of operating in a Global matrix environment.



  





**We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com.**
